title: Vice President, Contracting Innovation Lead
description:
About this role

Team Overview

BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset. We deliver world-class service to all of our clients, from wealth advisors to family offices to endowments and foundations.

About this Role

We are seeking a highly motivated professional to join our SMA & Models Contracting team and drive operational scale, process improvement, and innovation across our contracting function through automation, workflow optimization, and AI-enabled solutions. While the role will initially focus on driving innovation within the contracting space, it sits within the COO organization and offers opportunity to apply learnings more broadly across SMA Solutions and work cross-functionally to support the development and execution of an AI strategy framework for the SMA business to amplify innovation across the ecosystem.

This role will focus on enhancing the end-to-end contract lifecycle by identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, streamline stakeholder interactions, and support business growth. Working closely with Sales, Operations, Legal & Compliance, and other key stakeholder teams across BlackRock, the successful candidate will lead initiatives that improve how contractual work is managed, tracked, and delivered.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future operating model of a growing contracting organization process design, technology enablement, AI adoption, data-driven decision making, and change management.

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead process improvement, automation, and innovation initiatives across the contract lifecycle.

· Design and implement scalable workflow solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and stakeholder experience.

· Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, eliminate bottlenecks, improve turnaround times, and increase operational scale.

· Evaluate, develop, and deploy AI-enabled solutions, workflow automations, knowledge assistants, copilots, and other productivity tools that support contracting operations.

· Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve contract review, knowledge management, reporting, self-service support, and operational decision-making.

· Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize opportunities, and deliver practical, scalable solutions.

· Develop reporting, dashboards, and metrics to monitor operational performance and measure business impact.

· Create and maintain process documentation, playbooks, and training materials that promote consistency and adoption.

· Support governance, change management, and user adoption efforts associated with new tools, processes, and ways of working.

· Stay informed on trends and developments in AI, automation, contract lifecycle management, and legal operations, identifying opportunities to apply them within the contracting function.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 6 years of experience in contract management, legal operations, business operations, process improvement, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading process improvement, automation, technology implementation, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Experience supporting contract lifecycle management processes and related business workflows.
  • Experience with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, preferably DocuSign CLM.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation and low-code platforms such as Salesforce, Airtable, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI and automation technologies to solve business problems and improve operational efficiency.
  • Strong familiarity with generative AI tools and their practical application in business environments.
  • Experience building, configuring, or deploying workflow automations, AI-enabled assistants, copilots, agents, knowledge management solutions, or similar productivity tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, ChatGPT, Claude (Anthropic), Power Platform, Salesforce, Airtable, DocuSign CLM/IAM, or similar technologies is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen effectively and ask relevant questions.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience within financial services, legal, compliance, or other regulated environments is preferred.


For San Francisco, CA and Sausalito, CA Only the salary range for this position is USD$150,000.00 - USD$205,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.


Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

As the Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role will support invoice gathering, claim loading, validation checks, CLD processing, dispute documentation, payment package preparation, reporting, reconciliation support, SOP documentation, controls, and operational improvement activities.

The role will partner with the Medicaid Manager, AIN team members, ATO Medicaid process owners, Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Information Systems, and other U.S.-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Medicaid operations. The Associate will be expected to learn Medicaid processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution before taking on broader independent responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Medicaid Processing & Operational Execution

  • Support day-to-day execution of Medicaid rebate operations including invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, claim processing, payment package support, and documentation maintenance.
  • Execute assigned standard-state activities in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
  • Maintain accurate trackers for invoice status, CLD receipt, validation outcomes, open items, dispute status, payment package readiness, and evidence retention.
  • Flag risks, missing information, aged items, access issues, or process exceptions to the Medicaid Manager and ATO retained owners.

Invoice Validation & CLD Support

  • Perform first-pass invoice validation checks for assigned Medicaid states, including unit, NDC, reimbursement, URA, invoice, and source data reasonableness checks.
  • Support CLD formatting, control checks, historical utilization comparison, duplicate discount screening support, and preparation of analysis files for review.
  • Document validation findings, assumptions, supporting evidence, and required follow-up actions clearly and consistently.
  • Escalate complex state nuances, high-risk exceptions, unusual utilization trends, or ambiguous payment/dispute issues for manager or ATO review.

Dispute, Adjustment & Payment Package Support

  • Prepare dispute documentation, dispute tracking updates, response support, and evidence files for disputed units and rebate amounts.
  • Support preparation of ROSI, PQAS, remittance, payment package, and SharePoint archival documentation in accordance with SOP requirements.
  • Assist with prior quarter adjustments, supplemental claim support, interest calculation evidence, and payment reconciliation support as assigned.
  • Maintain clean audit trails, decision logs, and supporting workpapers for Medicaid invoice and payment activities.

Systems, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Use Model N / PbN, SAP, Validata, SharePoint, state portals, reporting tools, and Microsoft 365 applications to support Medicaid workflow execution.
  • Assist with UAT, defect documentation, access readiness tracking, SOP updates, work instruction drafting, training material preparation, and knowledge repository maintenance.
  • Participate in KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution activities to build Medicaid process proficiency.
  • Identify process gaps, manual effort reduction opportunities, recurring exceptions, documentation gaps, and quality improvement ideas.

Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness

  • Execute work in accordance with internal policies, Medicaid SOPs, controlled process requirements, documentation standards, and compliance expectations.
  • Maintain accurate evidence for invoice receipt, validation, disputes, payment support, approvals, reconciliations, and archival steps.
  • Escalate data integrity, compliance, financial, or operational risks promptly and support remediation activities as assigned.
  • Support audit, SOX, and control review activities by providing complete workpapers and organized documentation.

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Medicaid / managed markets operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should bring ownership, accuracy, curiosity, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to support compliant and timely Medicaid rebate execution.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebates, finance operations, revenue management, claims operations, analytics, or related controlled business operations.
  • Strong Excel, documentation, reporting, analytical, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet timelines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a deadline-driven and highly controlled environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Medicaid rebate operations, payer rebates, managed markets finance, claims validation, CLD processing, dispute tracking, rebate adjudication, Gross-to-Net, or pharmaceutical revenue management.
  • Experience with Model N / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable tools.
  • Understanding of NDC, AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, ROSI, PQAS, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, and compliance documentation is desirable.
  • Experience supporting SOPs, WSIs, audit-ready workpapers, issue trackers, UAT, system implementation, automation, or process improvement activities.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work with U.S.-based stakeholders in a distributed global operating model.

.

title: [MSO] OpenStack Engineer
description:
Project – the aim you’ll have

You will join an internal OpenStack team that builds and operates private and sovereign cloud platforms for enterprise clients in Western Europe. Environments range from multi region platforms across several data centres to compact telco and edge clusters. Key selling points: hands on work on client production platforms, mentoring from senior engineers and architects, and a defined path to senior level.

Role – how you’ll contribute

  • Install and configure OpenStack components with Kolla-Ansible in line with the approved design.
  • Prepare infrastructure nodes: operating system, KVM virtualisation, container runtime, network interfaces and storage access.
  • Configure networking and storage: OVN tenant networks, VLAN provider networks, Cinder volume types and boot from volume scenarios.
  • Deploy monitoring and logging: Prometheus with exporters, Alertmanager, Grafana, Fluentd and OpenSearch.
  • Handle second line incidents and service requests within the agreed service levels.
  • Execute planned changes and maintenance: patching, node replacement, virtual machine evacuation and upgrade support.
  • Maintain the configuration repositories through merge requests and promote changes between environments.
  • Automate repeatable work with Ansible and CI pipelines, and take part in the on call rotation.

Expectations – the experience you need

  • At least 3 years administering Linux in production, including operating or implementing OpenStack.
  • Day to day operation of the core services: Nova, Neutron, Keystone, Glance, Cinder, Placement and Horizon, including projects, quotas, flavors and images.
  • Ability to diagnose failed instance, volume and network operations using the OpenStack CLI and service logs.
  • Understanding of how the platform works internally: API, scheduler and agent components, the message queue and the state database.
  • Experience with an OpenStack deployment framework, preferably Kolla-Ansible, and with services running as containers.
  • KVM and libvirt at the level needed to troubleshoot a compute node, plus practical Ansible and Git skills.
  • Networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, NAT, filtering, overlay networks, and the difference between tenant and provider networks.
  • English at B2 level for technical documentation and daily contact with the client.

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack-Ansible or TripleO.
  • OVN or Open vSwitch, and enterprise storage over NFS or iSCSI.
  • Proxmox VE, VMware vSphere or another virtualisation platform, and experience with VMware migrations.
  • Python for operational tooling and API integrations, or Terraform and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to telco workloads or performance tuning such as SR-IOV, DPDK, CPU pinning and huge pages.
  • Certified OpenStack Administrator, or certifications in Linux, networking or cloud.

What we offer:

  • Flexible and remote cooperation options
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • Travels related to international projects
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Access* to language classes
  • Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Access* to private healthcare and life insurance
  • Access* to multisport card

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

JOB SUMMARY

The Product Manager is responsible for supporting the planning, delivery, and ongoing improvement of business products and technology-enabled capabilities across business areas. The role partners with business stakeholders to understand needs, define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and help deliver solutions that create measurable business value.

Acting as a bridge between business teams, technology teams, and external vendors, the Product Manager helps align product work with organizational goals while managing day-to-day priorities and stakeholder expectations for small to medium-sized initiatives

  • Product Planning and Roadmap Support: Support the development and maintenance of product roadmaps aligned with business objectives across assigned business areas. Help evaluate opportunities, define priorities, clarify product objectives, and track success measures.

  • Stakeholder Engagement and Business Partnership: Work with business leaders, managers, and subject matter experts to understand operational challenges, gather requirements, support prioritization, and ensure solutions align with agreed business needs. Communicate product updates, decisions, and progress to stakeholders.

  • Product Delivery and Initiative Coordination: Coordinate the delivery of product enhancements, technology implementations, and business initiatives. Apply project management practices to support delivery within agreed scope, timeline, and quality expectations, escalating risks or issues as needed

  • Vendor and Partner Coordination: Coordinate with software vendors, implementation partners, and service providers to support delivery activities, service expectations, issue resolution, and ongoing product needs. Provide input into vendor performance and service delivery discussions

  • Continuous Improvement and Product Optimization: Monitor product performance, user adoption, and business outcomes. Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and user experiences through data-driven recommendations and ongoing product enhancements.

  • Financial Responsibility: Monitors and reports on project-related CapEx spending, budget performance, and funding forecasts for product roadmap initiatives, identifying potential funding gaps and supporting approval requests as needed. Contributes to invoice reviews, spend validation, and budget planning discussions, while final invoice approval authority remains outside the role unless specifically delegated.

Knowledge and Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Associate Cyber Security Tester
description:
We believe in better. And we make it happen.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.

Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, SkyQ to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate.

We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love.

And we do it all right here at Sky.

Cyber Security

Our products, platforms and technologies are constantly evolving that’s why keeping Sky safe from cyber-attacks is one of our top priorities. Our Cyber Security team helps the business grow while protecting our customers, colleagues and partners from increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. Our team includes Cyber Fusion Centre, Security Services, Risk and Compliance, Programme Delivery and Business Security, and we work across the UK, Italy and Germany. Join us and you’ll get involved in tackling challenges and future threats in an ever-changing cyber landscape.

What you’ll do –

  • Show proficiency in managing your workload independently and familiarise yourself with industry business practices and procedures while taking ownership of your development pathway alongside your line manager and colleagues.
  • Work towards achieving a defined set of objectives identified between yourself and your line manager, tailoring to your goals and completing a pentesting certification.
  • Conduct penetration test engagements for both applications and complex infrastructure setups, as well as retests, to gain a deep understanding of how we conduct cyber security assessments across a wide range of systems and services here at Sky.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support research, vulnerability analysis and reporting while applying appropriate validation and professional judgement. Develop an understanding of the security risks associated with AI and LLM-based applications, and contribute to the assessment of these technologies during security testing.
  • Independently attend meetings where infrastructure and application scopes are defined, document the respective engagement terms, conduct and support cyber security assessments. This includes appropriately documenting and sharing all findings.
  • Work with various areas of the business to scope projects and advise teams on remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Gain a good understanding of how to conduct advanced infrastructure and advanced web application penetration tests.
  • Develop an understanding of modern security testing methodologies covering applications, infrastructure, mobile platforms and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled systems.
  • Conduct research into emerging technologies, security threats and testing methodologies, including the responsible use of AI-assisted tooling to improve the efficiency and quality of security testing.

What you’ll bring

Essential Criteria –

  • A passion for cyber security and a positive outlook and approach to the work we do.
  • Practical experience with penetration testing which can be substituted for a relevant degree or equivalent qualification or completion of the Sky Cyber Graduate Scheme.
  • A proven and demonstrable interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its application within cyber security, with an awareness of AI-assisted security tooling and the security considerations of AI-enabled applications.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, proactively exploring new technologies, attack techniques and security research to develop technical expertise.
  • Knowledge of common infrastructure and application pen test security tools.
  • Live the Sky Values and demonstrate enthusiasm and a can-do attitude.
  • Good time management and organisational skills to meet strict deadlines.
  • Be proactive and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Excellent teamwork skills to collaborate, share and support colleagues.
  • Ethical integrity to be trusted with confidential information.

Desirable skills and experience:

  • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  • PNPT (Practical Network Penetration Tester)
  • CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist)
  • CREST CRT
  • Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
  • AI/ML or GenAI certification (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Google, SANS/GIAC or equivalent), or demonstrable practical experience using AI/LLMs to automate or enhance security testing.

Benefits and perks

  • There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:
  • Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema
  • Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution
  • Private healthcare with mental health support
  • Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance
  • Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect
  • Share save and Tech schemes
  • A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

How you’ll work

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 2 days in the office per week.

Your office base

Our Sky Group HQ. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology and workspaces, there’s plenty of space to see your big ideas come to life. Here you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants and cafes. You can re-energise at our gym, catch the latest films at our cinema, get your car washed and even get pampered at our beauty salon.

Our Osterley Campus is just a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station, or you can get one of our free shuttle buses from Osterley, Gunnersbury and Ealing Broadway stations. Plus, there’s free onsite parking available for cars, motorbikes and bicycles.

Who we are

We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK. Please be aware Sky does not offer sponsorship for this position.

title: Production Line Operator
description:
Title: Production Technician

About Prysmian

Draka EHC, a brand of Prysmian, is a global manufacturer and supplier dedicated to sustainability and developing innovative products, technical services, and integrated solutions for the vertical transportation industry. We take pride in being a premier employer in Oshawa, Ontario.

Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video, and data transmission for the telecommunication sector.

We are 30,000 employees, across 50+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us.

Work Location: Oshawa, Ontario

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (8-hour shifts, with 2 weeks of day shifts and 2 weeks of afternoon shifts).

Benefits:

  • Eligible for benefits starting on your first day.
  • 3 weeks’ vacation to start.
  • Gain share bonus (potential)
  • 3 paid sick/personal days.

Position Summary

Working as a member of the team the Production Technician is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of various manufacturing and distribution processes to meet the company and customer’s expectations for quality and delivery of products.

This job can involve working on a variety of processes and therefore is split into three levels for training and job grading purposes. A Production Technician will start as a level one and work up to a level three.

Salary: $21.00 (hourly)

Responsibilities:

  • Operates complex machinery for manufacturing and joining plastic handrails. Performs maintenance, changes dies/extruders, and splices handrails to precise tolerances using hand tools.
  • Operates machinery to manufacture rubber handrails, assembles, splices, reworks defects, and adjusts molding equipment for style changes.
  • Sets up and operates Elevator Cut Line machinery. Retrieves and prepares cable, scans "Inventory Label" and "Cut Label" for accuracy, pulls cable through the "clock," attaches it to the reel, cuts to length, and wraps for shipping and identify parcel with a "Cut ticket"
  • Operates and sets up machines to slit, cut, extrude, join, or pre-assemble rubber materials. Adjusts equipment and changes dies for different styles and sizes.
  • Operates and sets up the bending machine and router to prepare brush holders and other parts.
  • Ensures inventory accuracy by labeling and tracking material discrepancies.
  • Keeps the workplace clean and organized to ensure efficient processes and defect-free products.
  • Handles special projects in the manufacturing areas as needed.
  • Packages finished parts according to approved methods and standards.
  • Health, Safety, and Integrated Management System: Maintains a safe and healthy environment by adhering to company Health & Safety policies, complies with current legislation, follows Draka EHC’s IMS procedures to reduce environmental impact, and ensures quality service by upholding Draka EHC standards and ISO procedures.
  • Inspection & Testing: Measures products with analog and digital gauges, visually inspects them against established standards, places suspected non-conforming products on hold, and maintains SPC graphs to adjust processes based on negative trends.
  • Reports & Administration & Other Related Duties: Maintains quality records in compliance with established standards, completes final inspection, inventory accuracy, and productivity reports, and prepares Certificates of Quality as required.
  • Training: May be asked to train other employees as requested by the Production Supervisor.
  • Team Effort: Collaborates with team members to support efforts, achieve team goals, and continuously improve processes and products.

Knowledge and skill requirements:

  • Completion of high school.
  • 3 years of experience in production processes using complex machinery is considered an asset.
  • High degree of hand-eye coordination required, with the ability to consistently handle over 35 kg and stand for extended periods.
  • Proven experience in inspection and testing within an ISO 9000-accredited manufacturing company.
  • Solid working knowledge of Quality Concepts, Basic SPC, blueprint reading, and inspection.
  • Proficient in ERP software, Microsoft Word, and email communication.

    • Supporting tax services and helping build tax clientele.
    • Sending complete and accurate credit denial letters within 30 days from the date of application.

  • Mileage reimbursement is provided for business use of personal vehicles, excluding normal commuting.

Experience That Will WOW Us!

  • Demonstrated self-confidence, organization, and adaptability.
  • A history of kindness, compassion, and helping others succeed.
  • A mindset focused on quality, problem-solving, and openness to new ideas.
  • Team-oriented approach – willing to pitch in, learn, and lead by example.
  • Basic computer proficiency and comfort learning new systems.
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a dependable vehicle.

Why World?

  • Growth-minded culture: 80% of our Financial Services Representatives are promoted to management.
  • Proven career paths: 75% of our Operations Executives began in similar roles.
  • Community connection: Paid volunteer hours each year to give back.
  • Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental, vision, and life insurance available to full-time team members beginning the 1st of the month following 30 days.
  • Work-life balance: Paid holidays, vacation time, and 401(k) with company match.
  • Belonging & purpose: Join a team built on respect, collaboration, and genuine care.
  • Be home for dinner: Your life outside of work is a priority.
  • Make an impact: Help customers build stronger financial futures every day.

Who Is World?

Since 1962, World Finance has helped millions of people unlock their financial good. We champion financial wellness and celebrate the hundreds of thousands of customers achieving better credit each year. Based in Greenville, SC, World serves over one million customers annually through personal loans and tax preparation services. With 1,200+ branches across 16 states, we’re proud to be the financial partner with heart — offering customer-focused service rooted in teamwork, community, and care.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Occasional climbing, kneeling, bending, twisting, and reaching.

  • Fast-paced, high-demand environment requiring professionalism and adaptability.
  • Frequent travel to branch locations; may include extended hours, evenings, or weekends.
  • Standard indoor office settings with typical noise, lighting, and temperature.
  • Frequent customer and coworker interaction; must communicate clearly and professionally.
  • Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality are essential.

title: Home Care Worker
description:
When was the last time you made a difference in someone's life?

It takes a special person to be a Care Worker and help the older members of our community to maintain their independence and wellbeing. We are looking for a person with at least 3 months experience in a similar professional role, to join the Silverchain team in Picton and surrounding areas.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy having variety in their day.
  • Are passionate about providing an excellent service.
  • Can build positive relationships with clients and their families.
  • Don’t sweat the small stuff. Sometimes your client will be having a bad day or traffic delays you, but you know not to take this personally and can shake it off before your next client.

title: Employee Relations Specialist
description:
ER

We're proud to be part of STARK Building Materials UK and dedicated to providing top-quality products and exceptional service to our customers. We're a friendly and collaborative team, passionate about what we do and committed to doing it well.

We’re searching for an Employee Relations Specialist to join us on a permanent basis at our Binley, Coventry HQ. The purpose of this role is to provide expert employee relations support across STARK UK, working in partnership with our outsourced Employee Relations provider to ensure consistent, commercially focused and legally compliant case management.

The role acts as the key link between the business and the outsourced provider, driving timely case progression, ensuring management actions are completed, identifying trends and risks, and supporting the continuous improvement of employee relations practices across the organisation.

The Employee Relations Specialist will also support complex cases, coach managers, monitor service delivery and help ensure a positive colleague experience while reducing organisational risk.

KEY RESULT AREAS

Employee Relations case oversight

  • Act as the internal point of contact for employee relations cases managed by the outsourced provider.
  • Track case progress, follow up outstanding manager actions and ensure cases move forward within agreed timescales.
  • Provide practical guidance to managers on disciplinary, grievance, absence, capability, probation, flexible working and performance matters.
  • Identify and escalate complex, sensitive or high-risk matters requiring additional HR, legal or business input.

Outsourced provider management

  • Build and maintain an effective working relationship with the outsourced Employee Relations provider.
  • Monitor service delivery, case quality, SLA performance and agreed ways of working.
  • Challenge delays or gaps in service and work with the provider to resolve issues quickly.
  • Support regular governance discussions and provide feedback on service performance, trends and improvement opportunities.

Risk, compliance and quality

  • Ensure employee relations activity is managed consistently and in line with company policy, employment legislation and ACAS best practice.
  • Maintain appropriate case records, documentation and evidence to support clear, auditable decision making.
  • Support preparation for employment tribunal claims, settlement discussions and external legal advice where required.
  • Identify recurring issues, risks or themes and recommend actions to reduce future ER risk.

Manager capability and continuous improvement

  • Coach managers to handle people matters confidently, consistently and at the earliest appropriate stage.
  • Support the development of manager guidance, tools and briefing materials linked to employee relations processes.
  • Use case data to identify areas where manager capability, policy clarity or process changes are needed.
  • Contribute to People Services improvement activity, including technology, reporting and self-service initiatives.

ATTRIBUTES, SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Experience managing employee relations cases including disciplinary, grievance, absence, capability, probation, flexible working and performance management matters.
  • Strong understanding of UK employment law, company policy and ACAS best practice, with the ability to apply this in a practical and commercially balanced way.
  • Confident coaching and influencing managers, helping them understand their responsibilities and progress cases in a timely and consistent way.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with HR colleagues, operational leaders, managers and external ER providers.

title: Responsible Wagering Analyst
description:
About the role

We are looking for an experienced Responsible Wagering Analyst to join our growing team on a Permanent Full Time Basis.

As the Responsible Wagering Analyst, you will be responsible for assessing customer wagering activity, identifying indicators of gambling-related harm, and supporting timely interventions in line with responsible wagering frameworks, policies and regulatory obligations. The role conducts customer reviews, check-in calls and written assessments, maintains accurate case records, and supports consistent customer protection outcomes.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Engaging with customers, experiencing, or at risk of experiencing, gambling-related harm.
  • Analysing customer data to support responsible wagering interventions and recommendations.
  • Preparing evidence-based assessments and customer protection recommendations.
  • Escalating complex or high-risk matters where required.
  • Supporting regulatory reporting, audits and reviews.
  • ​​​​​​​Identifying emerging harm trends and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

About you

To be successful in this role, you'll demonstrate:

  • Experience assessing customer risk and identifying indicators of gambling-related harm or vulnerability.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret behavioral, transactional and customer interaction data.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the preparation of assessments, case notes and recommendations.
  • Confidence managing sensitive customer conversations with empathy, professionalism and discretion.

title: Lead Security Professional
description:
This is what we offer you

Gross monthly salary between € 5.994 and € 8.563 (scale 10).

  • Thirteenth month's salary and 8% holiday allowance

  • 10% Employee Benefit Budget

  • EUR 1,400 development budget per year

  • Hybrid working: balance between home and office work (possible for most roles)

  • A pension, for which you can set the maximum amount of your personal contribution

View all our benefits.

Job Title

Lead Security Professional

Job Description

Strengthen security across Tribe FEC by turning complex risks and policies into clear decisions, practical actions and consistent ways of working.

You & your role

As Lead Security Professional, you know the secrets of turning complex security requirements into practical actions. You lead the tribe wide security community, drive alignment on priorities and ways of working, and ensure that security topics are addressed consistently across the tribe.

You create a clear view of the security posture, align priorities and support informed decisions. Without formal line-management responsibility, you challenge, advise and connect teams, senior leaders and central security stakeholders.

Examples from practice

  • Translate central security policies, standards and controls into clear, actionable plans for technology teams.

  • Monitor security risks, findings, exceptions and remediation activities, and escalate critical or recurring issues.

  • Facilitate tribe-wide security forums and support coaching, peer reviews and knowledge sharing.

Facts & figures

  • 36-40 hours per week.

  • 5 core responsibility areas, covering functional leadership, security standards, reporting, remediation and capability development.

  • Over 48,000 Rabobank colleagues worldwide.

Top 3 responsibilities

  • Provide functional leadership to Security Professionals and align priorities, quality expectations and ways of working across the tribe.

  • Deliver clear reporting on security risks, overdue actions and progress to support decisions by the Tribe Leadership Team.

  • Act as the primary security counterpart for the tribe towards the CISO organisation and ensure that enterprise security standards are translated into practical and consistent implementation.

Together, you help ensure that security is an integral part of delivery and decision-making. You also advise on security capacity, priorities and capability development across the tribe.

Together we achieve more than alone

We believe in the power of differences. By combining people's differences, we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you will bring to our team.

Together with your colleagues, you help the tribe manage security risks and apply Rabobank’s security framework consistently. Collaboration is our way of working, as one expert team within Rabobank. You connect leadership, technology teams Security Professionals, Security Champions and central security stakeholders around a shared security vision.

Work on yourself & the world around you

For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That is why we want to invest in you and work together to create a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: “At Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you simultaneously.”

This is reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid work environment and a good work-life balance. You can also work on banking matters for our personal and business clients, as well as on social issues such as the food and energy transitions.

Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank

At Rabobank, we are working towards a culture where everyone feels welcome. We value our differences and use them to collaborate more effectively and make better decisions. We do this step by step, paying attention to what is going well and to the areas where we can continue to improve.

By being open to different perspectives, we are creating an environment where colleagues feel heard. That helps us build an organisation where people enjoy working and where we truly understand and serve our customers.

You & your talent

  • Bachelor or master's degree in cyber security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Extensive experience in information security, cyber security, or security governance.

  • Experience working in large-scale technology organisations and agile environments.

  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, risk management, and control implementation.

  • Experience advising senior leadership teams on security risks and priorities.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to drive collaboration across multiple departments and disciplines.

  • Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, SABSA, or equivalent.

You & the application process

You can apply for the Solution Architect vacancy at Rabobank until the position is filled.

  • Questions about working at Rabobank and the process? Oscar van Dijk, Recruiter, via oscar.vandijk@rabobank.nl.

  • Answers to frequently asked questions can be found at .

  • A security screening is part of the procedure.

  • We respect your privacy.

title: Reception/Lobby Coach
description:
RECEPTIONIST/ LOBBY COACH


About KidStrong

KidStrong is a child development and fitness program designed to help parents build stronger, smarter, high-character kids.

At KidStrong, the experience we create for families begins before a child ever steps onto the coaching floor. Our Lobby Coach plays an important role in making every child, parent/caregiver and guest feel welcomed, recognized and excited to be part of our community.


The Role

The Receptionist / Lobby Coach is the host of the KidStrong lobby and an important part of our member experience team.

This is much more than a traditional front-desk position.

You will be one of the first people families see when they arrive and one of the last people they interact with before leaving. You will help create a warm, organized and energetic environment, build relationships with our members, welcome new families, support our Amazing Trial Experience, and make sure important front-of-house administrative details are taken care of.

The right person for this role genuinely enjoys people, notices the little things and understands that exceptional customer service is about making people feel seen, welcomed and valued.

What You’ll Do

Create an Exceptional Member Experience

  • Warmly greet children and parents/caregivers as they arrive.
  • Learn and use children’s names whenever possible.
  • Create a welcoming, positive and professional lobby environment.
  • Build genuine relationships with our members and families.
  • Help children and caregivers feel comfortable and connected when they enter the centre.
  • Answer routine questions and help families find the information or support they need.
  • Recognize opportunities to celebrate children and strengthen the family’s connection to KidStrong.
  • Help ensure the experience from arrival through departure reflects KidStrong’s standards and values.
Deliver the Amazing Trial Experience

Our trial families are experiencing KidStrong for the first time, and the Lobby Coach plays an important role in making that experience exceptional.

You will:

  • Review upcoming trials and prepare before families arrive
  • Ensure starter kits and required trial materials are ready.
  • Personally welcome trial children and their parents/caregivers.
  • Help families understand what to expect during their visit.
  • Deliver the KidStrong Amazing Trial Experience consistently.
  • Build rapport with prospective members and answer questions about the KidStrong experience.
  • Communicate with Coaches and centre leadership so trial families receive a seamless experience.
  • Support families through the enrollment process.
  • Complete required trial documentation and follow-up.
  • Contribute to trial conversion and membership growth while keeping the experience warm, authentic and family-focused.

Support Front-of-House Operations

  • Complete required administrative tasks before classes whenever possible.
  • Complete outstanding administrative work following the final class when necessary.]
  • Review class and trial schedules and help ensure the centre is prepared for arriving families.
  • Maintain accurate member and trial information.
  • Assist with routine member communication and front-desk administration.
  • Keep the lobby and front-desk area organized, professional and ready for families.
  • Identify member questions, concerns or follow-up needs and ensure they reach the appropriate person.
  • Handle member and child information professionally and confidentially.
Work as Part of the KidStrong Team

  • Communicate proactively with Coaches, Lead Coaches and centre leadership.
  • Share information that may help Coaches better support a child or family.
  • Help create smooth transitions between the lobby and coaching floor.
  • Pitch in during busy periods and support the overall success of the centre.
  • Contribute to a positive, respectful and collaborative workplace.
  • Be dependable, prepared and ready to contribute at the beginning of each shift.
  • Receive coaching and feedback positively and apply it to your work.
  • Follow KidStrong policies, procedures and safety expectations.
You May Be a Great Fit If You…

  • Genuinely enjoy interacting with children and families.
  • Are naturally warm, friendly and comfortable starting conversations.
  • Remember people’s names and details and enjoy making people feel welcome.
  • Are organized and good at keeping track of multiple small details.
  • Notice when something needs to be done and take initiative.
  • Are dependable and follow through on commitments.
  • Can balance customer service with administrative responsibilities.
  • Are comfortable talking with prospective members and supporting enrolment.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally.
  • Enjoy working as part of an energetic team.
  • Are comfortable in a busy children’s fitness environment.
  • Can remain positive and professional when things get busy.
  • Are open to feedback, learning and continued development.
Experience in customer service, reception, hospitality, recreation, children’s programming, administration, membership services or sales is an asset, but finding someone with the right attitude, reliability and ability to connect with families is equally important to us.


Schedule

This is a part-time position requiring availability for a combination of mornings, evenings and weekends.
Our families benefit from seeing familiar faces, so consistent availability and reliability are important parts of this position.
Schedules are developed based on centre needs and employee availability.

Requirements
Successful candidates will be required to:

  • Complete KidStrong onboarding and role-specific training
  • Meet KidStrong employment and background-screening requirements.
  • Obtain/maintain Child and Infant First Aid and CPR certification.
  • Follow KidStrong safety, confidentiality and professional conduct expectations.
  • Obtain a current Police Vulnerable Sector Check
What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • Children walk through the door and are excited that you know their name.
  • Parents feel comfortable approaching you with questions.
  • New families immediately feel that we were expecting them and are happy they’re here.
  • Trial families receive a consistent, engaging and well-organized experience.
  • Administrative details don’t fall through the cracks.
  • Coaches have the information they need to support families.
  • You follow through when something needs attention.
  • Families leave feeling connected to KidStrong and excited to return.
Our Purpose

We help parents build stronger, smarter, high-character kids.
As our Lobby Coach, you help bring that purpose to life by making sure every family feels welcomed, supported and valued from the moment they walk through our doors.

Compensation Structure
Hourly compensation rate: $15/hr
Commission on ATE converted in Centre: $10/membership sign up

title: Kettle Coordinator
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY:
The Salvation Army Christmas Kettle Campaign is part of a century old tradition to contribute towards building strong communities by helping TSA to give hope to other.
Kettle Coordinator II position is a short-term contract position. The incumbent is responsible for oversight of several Christmas Kettle locations in a given geographical zone area. Zone locations include shopping malls, grocery stores and retail outlets.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:
The incumbent may perform all, some, or similar range of duties.
• Attend a day of training/orientation on The Salvation Army and the Christmas Kettle Campaign
• Provide support in getting Kettles to zone locations prior to volunteer arrival at Campaign onset
• Ensure all Kettle donations are delivered to secure location at shift completion
• Communicate daily issues and supply deficiencies to City/Assistant Coordinator
• Orient and remind volunteers on proper Kettle handling and duties as required
• Supervise, support and assign (as required) Kettle Volunteers throughout the Campaign
• Participate in the recruitment of new volunteers
• Visit locations during shift changes and intermittently
• Communicate daily with ATL partner for effective transition
• Ensure timesheets and mileage reports are submitted accurately and timely (weekly basis)
• Remain at the Kettle for the full shift (until relieved), ensuring security of donations received.
• Respond to questions/queries from potential donors regarding SA ministries and programs.
• Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

CRITICAL RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT:
Governance Boards and Councils: n/a
Internal: TSA staff members, Kettle campaign team
External: Community members

MANAGERIAL/TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Reports directly to the _____.
Direct reports: none.
Workflow coordinator.

FINANCIAL AND MATERIAL MANAGEMENT:
• Collect donations and petite cash and ensure donations are always kept secure.
The above responsibilities must be discharged in accordance with The Salvation Army’s Mission Statement, in a professional manner, upholding our code of conduct.

WORKING CONDITIONS:
• Work environment is typically in malls/stores
• Standing for long periods will be required and exposure to cold weather

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.
• Work in compliance with OH&S Act and Regulations and abide by The Salvation Army’s health and safety policies and procedures.
Alternative combination of education and Experience may be considered.

Education, Qualifications and Certifications:
• Some high school coursework, completion of high school is an asset

Experience:
• One year of related experience or working in customer service
• Money handling experience is an asset
• Related experience is an asset

Skills and Capabilities
• Valid driver’s license and a reliable vehicle required Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Enthusiastic Team Player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Able to lift 9 to 12 kgs (20 – 25 lbs)
• Strong customer service skills; enjoy liaising and working with people of all ages and abilities
• Willingness to be flexible and work well under pressure with daily timelines and changing priorities
• Ability to maintain strict confidentiality in the handling of donor, volunteer, and organizational information

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $18.50 to $23.13 with a maximum of $27.76.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.

title: Home Care Worker
description:
It takes a special person to be a Home Care Worker and help the older members of our community to maintain their home and enhance their wellbeing. We are looking for just that person to join the Silverchain team in Penrith and surrounding suburbs.

What’s on offer

  • Award rate $43.03 per hour + Super + Paid KM's
  • Employee benefits program + salary packaging up to $18,550 tax free each year
  • Paid CPR and First Aid courses.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy having variety in their day.
  • Are passionate about providing an excellent service.
  • Can build positive relationships with clients and their families.
  • Care about assisting our aged community members to live independently at home for longer.
  • Don’t sweat the small stuff. Sometimes your client will be having a bad day or traffic delays you, but you know not to take this personally and can shake it off before your next client.
  • Are comfortable working independently and finding solutions to everyday problems, knowing when to ask your manager for help.

In addition, you will need:

  • A valid Australian Driver's Licence & your own insured, roadworthy vehicle
  • An interest in community care or aged care (3 - 6 months previous experience in a similar role).

The role

In the role of Home Care Worker you will be providing our aged care clients with home help services, such as:

  • General housekeeping and making beds
  • Cleaning, mopping and vacuuming floors
  • Washing, folding and ironing laundry
  • Meal preparation and grocery shopping
  • Providing social support and transport to lifestyle activities
  • Helping the family carer to have a break or an opportunity to do other things.

Why choose Silverchain

  • Everyone at Silverchain, from our care teams to leadership, plays a vital role in delivering Best Care. It’s a team effort.
  • Best Care is care that is safe, personal, connected and effective.
  • We are proudly one of the few Australian home care providers accredited in both national health and aged care standards. This means the quality of care we provide is expected to meet the same standards as a hospital or residential aged care facility.
  • As a not for profit organisation, we re-invest our funds into research and developing innovative models of care to set the industry benchmark for the provision of the best care in the home.
  • We'll also provide you with opportunities to help you develop and grow in your career, with training and education programs to help you achieve your goals.

How to apply

To submit your application, click ‘Apply’.

At Silverchain Group, we recognise the positive contribution that a diverse workforce makes to our organisation where individuals can be authentic, are respected and celebrated. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, people of all ages, gender, abilities, culturally diverse and linguistic backgrounds.

Prior to commencement, every preferred candidate must complete a Statutory Declaration, National Police check, Working Rights check and pre-employment functional assessment. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.

title: National Project Director
description:
Job Description:

Lead the projects, infrastructure and investments shaping the future of healthcare.

  • Drive nationally significant healthcare infrastructure projects: Lead the planning, development and delivery of major property, construction and capital works programs across one of Australia's largest health and aged care organisations.

  • Influence strategic decisions at an enterprise level: Partner with Executive Leaders, CEOs, CFOs, clinical leaders and government stakeholders to deliver development initiatives that support the future of healthcare and aged care.

  • Shape a better and fairer health system: Oversee projects that enhance healthcare facilities, improve patient outcomes and support the growth of services across public hospitals, private hospitals, aged care and virtual care.


About St Vincent's Health Australia

At St Vincent's Health Australia, we are shaping a future health and aged care system that supports people with life-changing care, wherever and whoever they are.

Founded by the Sisters of Charity in 1857, St Vincent's is one of Australia's leading not-for-profit health and aged care organisations. Our 30,000 dedicated people provide compassionate care through public and private hospitals, aged care residences, virtual care and services delivered at home across New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria.

Our vision is for every person to receive excellent and compassionate care through a better and fairer health and aged care system. Together, we are focused on enhancing our impact, connecting care and transforming the system. Our work is grounded in our values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced National Project Director to join our Property Management team.

This National role is open to candidates based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane, providing the opportunity to influence major healthcare infrastructure projects across St Vincent's Health Australia's extensive property portfolio throughout New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria.

Reporting to the National Director, Property Management, this critical leadership role is responsible for overseeing enterprise strategy, property development and construction projects across St Vincent's national property portfolio. Applications are welcomed from candidates based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane, with flexibility to travel across the east coast of Australia as required

You will provide strategic leadership across a diverse portfolio of healthcare infrastructure projects, including project planning, development, feasibility, refurbishment, reconfiguration, construction delivery, operational commissioning and post-completion management.

Working closely with executive leaders, hospital leadership teams, clinicians, finance, procurement, legal, technology and external partners, you will help shape and deliver the infrastructure that supports healthcare services for generations to come.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a senior project leader to combine strategic influence, commercial acumen and healthcare infrastructure expertise within a purpose-driven organisation.


Your Key Responsibilities

As a senior leader within the Property Management function, you will:

  • Lead the planning, development and delivery of major healthcare infrastructure and capital works projects across the national portfolio.

  • Drive enterprise project governance, systems, processes and delivery frameworks.

  • Oversee project feasibility, cost planning, design management and development strategies.

  • Manage complex construction, refurbishment, redevelopment and commissioning programs.

  • Ensure projects align with strategic priorities, operational objectives and healthcare service requirements.

  • Lead stakeholder engagement across executive teams, hospital leadership, clinicians, consultants, contractors and government bodies.

  • Provide financial oversight and management of capital expenditure, project budgets and enterprise programs of work.

  • Identify and mitigate project risks relating to cost, quality, safety, delivery and performance.

  • Negotiate contracts and commercial agreements to ensure risks are effectively managed and project objectives are achieved.

  • Drive value creation through proactive identification of growth opportunities, service improvements and strategic investments


About You

You are an accomplished project and infrastructure leader with a proven track record delivering large-scale property, construction, health infrastructure or capital works projects in complex stakeholder environments.

You combine strategic thinking, commercial acumen and operational excellence with the ability to navigate competing priorities and deliver outcomes that align with organisational objectives. You are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels and are recognised for your ability to influence stakeholders, solve complex challenges and drive project success.

You have successfully partnered with Executive Leadership Teams, clinicians, hospital management, consultants, contractors and government agencies, building trusted relationships that enable collaboration, progress and successful delivery.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a purpose-led organisation whose facilities, infrastructure and services directly impact patients, residents, employees and communities across Australia.


You Will Bring

  • Tertiary qualifications in Architecture, Project Management, Construction Management or a related discipline.

  • Proven experience leading projects valued in excess of $10 million.

  • A minimum of 7 years' experience developing and delivering healthcare infrastructure projects.

  • Extensive experience working with clinicians, hospital executives and healthcare stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated success leading complex project teams and managing diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Strong experience in project feasibility, cost planning, design management and procurement.

  • Extensive capability in project financial administration, capital expenditure management and enterprise-level reporting.

  • Proven expertise in contractor, consultant and stakeholder management.

  • Experience managing project quality, risk and safety throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Strong contract management and procurement experience.

  • The ability to manage multiple major projects simultaneously while maintaining oversight of cost, quality, programme and risk outcomes.

  • Flexibility to travel across the east coast of Australia as required.


Highly regarded:

  • Project Management qualifications.

  • Experience in hospital planning and design.

  • WHS experience within a project management environment.

  • Client-side or contractor-side project director experience.

Why Join St Vincent's?

  • Deliver projects with lasting impact
    Help create the hospitals, healthcare facilities and environments that support communities across Australia.

  • Lead nationally significant initiatives
    Oversee major healthcare infrastructure, redevelopment and construction projects that directly support patient care and service delivery.

  • Partner with influential stakeholders
    Work alongside Executive Leaders, hospital executives, clinicians, government agencies and industry experts.

  • Drive strategic growth and innovation
    Support investment, development and transformation initiatives that shape the future of health and aged care.

  • Join a values-led organisation
    Build your career in an organisation guided by Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence, with a longstanding commitment to delivering better and fairer care.

  • Make a meaningful difference
    This is more than a project leadership role. It is an opportunity to help deliver the infrastructure, facilities and services that enable life-changing healthcare and aged care outcomes for generations to come.

If you are a senior project, development, infrastructure or construction leader seeking executive influence, complex projects and a stronger sense of purpose, we would welcome your application.

Apply Now

Join St Vincent's Health Australia and help shape the future of healthcare infrastructure across Australia.

Applications may close before the advertised closing date.

Important Information

Employment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including identification, right-to-work, reference and nationally coordinated criminal history checks. The successful applicant must also comply with applicable St Vincent's Health Australia policies and screening requirements.


St Vincent's Health Australia welcomes people from all backgrounds and beliefs. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute their unique experiences.
