Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Expand your horizons, advance your career, and contribute to a secure future for generations. Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector invites you to bring your pioneering spirit to our collaborative teams. As a Machine Perception (MP) Engineer – Level 2 or 3 located in Dulles, VA, you’ll be a linchpin in missions of paramount importance, defining the art of the possible from day one. This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.

This role will support our Spacecraft Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) department, located in Dulles, Virginia.


Space Systems is designing, building, and testing spacecraft for DoD, NASA, and commercial customers. We are leaders in innovative solutions to the evolving fields of space-based autonomous rendezvous and docking and rapid design/production of small satellites. We are seeking highly talented and ambitious engineers with backgrounds in Machine Perception, including Computer Vision (CV), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML). Experience and/or education in spacecraft navigation, robotics, and/or embedded processing is preferred.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off.

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

The MP engineer will work within the GNC subsystem team and is expected to:

  • Design, integrate, and validate precision actuator-driver position systems for optical test and calibration

  • Develop and maintain software interfaces between camera hardware SDKs/DLLs and C++/C#/Matlab, enabling synchronized image acquisition with actuator motion

  • Assist in characterize and calibrate camera/optical system performance (PSF, MTF, distortion, FOV) using custom or COTS test benches

  • Implement closed-loop and coordinated multi-axis motion control schemes, including coarse/fine position architectures

  • Develop motion planning routines (scan patterns, trajectory generation) to support test cell or hardware in the loop (HITL) demonstrations

  • Support system-level test architectures, including HIL setups simulating long-range or dynamic scenarios

  • Document test procedures, calibration results, and system performance for engineering review

  • Collaborate with senior engineers across optics, controls, and software disciplines to mature system designs

If this job description reads like it was written specifically for you, consider joining our team!

This position is contingent upon the candidate obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of professional experience – OR – a Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Optical Engineering, or a related field

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Top-Secret security clearance. US citizenship

  • Interest or experience integrating actuators/motion controllers into test or measurement systems (open-loop and closed-loop)

  • Experience interfacing vendor hardware SDKs/DLLs with MATLAB or C++ (e.g., MEX, loadlibrary/calllib, .NET interop)

  • Working knowledge of camera optics fundamentals (focal length, pixel pitch, FOV)

  • Proficiency in C/C++ or C# and Matlab

  • Some experience with control systems concepts (PID, feedforward control) as applied to positioning systems

  • Strong problem-solving skills and interest in hands-on hardware integration work

Basic Qualifications for Level 3:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 3 years of professional experience – OR – PhD with 1 year of professional experience. (Degree must be in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Optical Engineering, or a related field)

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Top-Secret security clearance. US citizenship

  • Interest or experience integrating actuators/motion controllers into test or measurement systems (open-loop and closed-loop)

  • Experience interfacing vendor hardware SDKs/DLLs with MATLAB or C++ (e.g., MEX, loadlibrary/calllib, .NET interop)

  • Working knowledge of camera optics fundamentals (focal length, pixel pitch, FOV)

  • Proficiency in C/C++ or C# and Matlab

  • Some experience with control systems concepts (PID, feedforward control) as applied to positioning systems

  • Strong problem-solving skills and interest in hands-on hardware integration work

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active/Current Top Secret

  • MS or PhD degree in engineering, physics, or math

  • Experience with computer vision / image processing algorithm development

  • Background in EO/IR sensor systems or space/defense optical payloads

  • Familiarity with communication protocols for motion controllers (Serial, GPIB, USB, EtherCAT)

  • Strong foundation in numerical methods and linear algebra (e.g. optimization, state estimation, coordinate transformations, numerical solvers)

  • Exposure to realistic scene generation/rendering (e.g., physically-based rendering, synthetic sensor imagery, simulation environments)

  • GPU programming experience (e.g., CUDA, OpenCL, shader-based pipelines) for real time rendering or accelerated image processing.

title: System Engineer - Platform Integration
description:
We are looking for System Engineer (PIT) specialized in AI Server Bring-up to drive the integration of our Secure AI™ engine into high-performance computing environments. You will leverage deep expertise in Linux kernel internals and low-level communication protocols (MCTP, eSPI, LTPI) to build robust, secure, and reliable server management solutions for global customers.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Implement firmware features that enable communication with peripherals via SPI, I2C, SGPIO, LTPI, PCIe, and other relevant protocols, following chipset specifications and datasheets.

2. Collaborate closely with customers to provide technical guidance, ensuring they understand and resolve platform integration challenges effectively. Offer both strategic and day-to-day technical support for assigned accounts.

3. Troubleshoot complex technical issues in diverse customer environments, applying broad concepts and innovative problem-solving to deliver effective solutions.

4. Ensure security compliance, including secure boot mechanisms and platform root of trust, maintaining robust security across the system.

5. Integrate Secure AI™ engine solutions into customer platforms, supporting

NVIDIA, Intel, and AMD-based systems to enhance AI-driven functionality.

6. Develop and maintain BMC software for system monitoring, event logging, WebUI, and other essential platform functionalities.

1. 10+ years of experience in firmware engineering, specializing in embedded systems and platform integration.

2. Proficient in C, C++, assembly language, shell scripting, and Python for firmware development.

3. Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals, including kernel architecture, applications, and IPC.

4. Strong expertise in low-level protocols, including I2C, I3C, GPIO, USB, LTPI, SGPIO, UART, and MCTP, eSPI, SSIF.

5. Strong capability in BMC porting, with the ability to independently adapt BMC solutions to custom hardware and proprietary algorithms.

6. Experience working with embedded systems, microcontrollers, FPGAs, and ARM-based architectures.

7. Comprehensive knowledge of firmware architecture, including bare-metal programming and security implementations.

Preferred Skills:

1. Extensive experience in end-to-end server bring-up and the architectural development of high-performance AI server platforms.

2. Experience working with OpenBMC stack, including customization and integration for various platforms.

Compensation Range - $80,000 - $200000

title: CVOR - Anesthesia Tech
description:
How would you like to work in a place where your contributions and ideas are valued? A place where you can serve with compassion, pursue excellence and honor every voice? At Wellstar, our mission is simple, yet powerful: to enhance the health and well-being of every person we serve. We are proud to have become a shining example of what's possible when the brightest professionals dedicate themselves to making a difference in the healthcare industry, and in people's lives.

Work Shift

Various (United States of America)

Job Summary:

Functions under the direction of the CVOR Department Director, Manager, Clinical Coordinator and Anesthesiologist. Provides age appropriate patient care, which addresses biological, emotional, developmental, psychosocial and patient/family educational needs. Has expanded cardiovascular experience in complex, multi problem, urgent, emergent and lifesaving cardiac operative procedures. Has in depth knowledge regarding biomedical equipment and physiology of the heart. The Cardiovascular Anesthesia Technologist assists the peri operative team in the operating room with cardiac surgery procedures, including but not limited to Coronary Artery Bypasses, Valve replacements, Aneurysm Repairs, Emergency procedures, Temporary and Permanent Pacemaker Implantation, Cardioversions, Intra-Aortic Balloon Pumps, Pericardial Window procedures, Ecmo procedures, VAD procedures (LVAD, BI-VAD, RVAD), TAVR procedures, Convergent procedures, VATS procedures, and Tegs . Administers direct and in-direct care of patients undergoing the above procedures with supervision from the Registered Nurse, Clinical Coordinator and Manager.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Set up anesthesia supplies in OR suites including pumps IV lines and IV fluids. Assist anesthesiologists in preoperative line placements ie: central lines, swan ganz catheters, arterial lines, etc. Troubleshoot and maintain all corresponding equipment. Picks up patients for surgery and assists patient transport to and from holding areas to surgical suites and to recovery areas. Assist with patient transfer to OR bed. Responsible for placement of EKG leads, R2 pads, and any other monitoring devices as needed under the supervision and direction of physicians, and nursing. Ability to understand, direct, teach and troubleshoot invasive/non-invasive monitoring equipment. Maintains skills and competency checks for identified equipment and quality control responsibilities. Obtain blood products, pharmacy products or any other products as needed. Maintain competency in obtaining, setting up and managing IABP during procedures. Provides support as needed to the cardiac ICU and Cath lab with IABP management and troubleshooting. Pick up ICU beds and prepare transport monitors / cables in a timely manner. Obtain supplies/equipment needed by anesthesia and OR staff throughout procedures as needed. Mop, clean and turn over OR suites at end of case and ensure proper stock of anesthesia supplies for to follow case. Cleans bins in anesthesia workroom and anesthesia supply carts and checks each for outdates. Manage and restock inventory of all specialty supplies and anesthesia carts. Stock sheets, blankets etc. Maintain and stock appropriate levels of fluid in warmer/ refrigerator and linen and trash bags. Maintains and restocks surgical scrub supplies at scrub sinks, at OR entrances, and dressing rooms with hats, masks and shoe covers. Checks and replaces sharps containers in CVORs and CARU cardiac prep rooms. Assists RNs and surgical technicians with room set up, supply management and patient charges. Flexible to the high call volume to support over 1000 cases per year. Must be flexible with schedule and understanding in the urgency of care with cardiac patients. Schedule may be altered by manager when other staff members are on vacation and / or when the needs of the schedule dictate. Must demonstrate positive teamwork behavior and communication. Will be required to teach and orient new staff. Participates in performance improvement, quality measures, NPSGs, nursing shared governance and all other department projects and meetings. Must support the departments needs, take direction with ease and perform all other duties as assigned. Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

Required Minimum Education:

High school diploma Required or equivalent Required and IABP management training within 6 months of hire. Required

Required Minimum License(s) and Certification(s):

All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.
  • Cert Anesthesia Tech-Preferred
  • Basic Life Support or BLS - Instructor

Additional License(s) and Certification(s):

Maintains BCLS certification Upon Hire Required

Required Minimum Experience:

Minimum 3 years recent experience in cardiovascular specialty Required

Required Minimum Skills:

In depth knowledge of network computer applications, invasive/non- invasive monitoring, defibrillator testing, trouble shooting of all perioperative anesthesia equipment required and monitoring all temperature regulated equipment. Must be able to effectively communicate and understand verbal and written English language and display a positive attitude.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a technical lead for the SEIT EDI team. This position is located in Roy, UT and supports the Sentinel program.

This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

What You’ll Get To Do:

This candidate will join the System Integration (SI) team under Sentinel Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test (SEIT) working on electrical design integration (EDI) at the Weapon System Integration (WSI) level. The function of this role will assist the WSI EDI team’s mission to identify, assess and resolve requirement, architecture and process gaps that impact design continuity and integrity to ensure successful weapon system integration and full lifecycle capability effectiveness.

Specific duties to include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Develop Capital interconnect & logic diagrams in support of Weapon System Architecture development.
  • Support electrical design of cross-segment Weapon System hardware.
  • Review engineering deliverables such as interface control documents (ICDs), system one-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, part data sheets, interconnect connect diagrams, specifications, electrical analysis and trade studies.
  • May perform research, trade studies, evaluation, and systems integration in electrical or electro-mechanical systems, cables, connectors, power systems, test equipment, and more.
  • Develop courses of action (COAs) and recommended path forward in support of gap/problem resolution.
  • Attend internal program, and/or technical exchange meetings.
  • Support formal program milestone events.
  • Working in a fast-paced work environment with high expectations, significantly diverse assignments, and collaborative settings across all levels.
  • Ensure appropriate coordination between electrical design and other integration teams.
  • Coordinate electrical system engineering content and work products.

Basic Qualifications:

This requisition may be filled at either the Principal Engineer Systems level (T-03) or Sr Principal Engineer Systems level (T-04).

Both Levels:

  • Must be a US Citizen with an active DoD Secret Clearance.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
  • Strong problem solving and critical thinking abilities.
  • Must have experience developing electrical designs using tools such as Capital, AutoCAD, or similar design software tools.
  • Knowledge of interconnect architecture development.
  • Work across disciplines and functional groups for design uniformity.

Principal Engineer (T03):

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited university and 5 years of experience, or 3 years of experience with a Master’s degree.
  • 1+ years of experience in creating Siemens Systems architecture with Capital Architect / Logic Siemens, interconnect diagrams, and single-line diagrams.
  • Familiarity with CAD/ECAD tools for cable design (Siemens Capital: Harness).
  • 1+ years of experience with one or more of the following:
    • Requirements management/analysis/allocations including the use of DOORS or equivalent
    • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBE/MBSE) practices, languages and/or tools such as Cameo, Rhapsody or MagicDRAW
    • Interface development experience
    • Architecture development experience
    • Verification including verification method determination, RVAM development

Sr Principal Engineer (T04):

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited university and 8 years of experience, or 6 years of experience with a Master’s degree, or 4 years of experience with a PhD.
  • 2+ years of experience in creating Siemens Systems architecture with Capital Architect / Logic Siemens, interconnect diagrams, and single-line diagrams.
  • Familiarity with CAD/ECAD tools for cable design (Siemens Capital: Harness)
  • 2+ years of experience with one or more of the following:
    • requirements management/analysis/allocations including the use of DOORS or equivalent
    • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBE/MBSE) practices, languages and/or tools such as Cameo, Rhapsody or MagicDRAW
    • Interface development experience
    • Architecture development experience
    • Verification including verification method determination, RVAM development
  • Understanding of systems modeling, electrical design, and performance characteristics (e.g., voltage rating, current carrying capacity, shielding).
  • Familiarity with industry/Military standards and codes (IEC, NEC, NFPA, IEC 60332, IEEE 299, UL, NEC 770, ISO 9001).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Siemens NX, especially for cable routing.
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with the following standards: SAE-AS50881, MIL-STD-1553, MIL-HDBK-516, MIL-STD-464 or similar.

title: Security Officer - MGM National Harbor
description:
National Harbor, Maryland

The SHOW comes alive at MGM Resorts International

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to work in a place full of excitement, diversity, and entertainment? THE JOB:

Security Officers play a key role in creating a safe, welcoming environment for everyone. From patrolling the property and monitoring cameras to responding to emergencies and supporting guests, this role is all about staying alert, taking action, and making people feel secure.


THE DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Guest & Team Member Support Respond professionally to guest and employee concerns, maintaining a calm and courteous presence. Serve as a first responder in emergencies, administering first aid when required and following established reporting protocols.

  • Gaming & Incident Reporting Handle secure gaming transactions and drops with accuracy. Maintain detailed reports on daily activity, incidents, property damage, and any unusual occurrences.

  • Dispatch & Emergency Coordination Manage communications through phone and two-way radio, dispatching information as needed. In urgent situations, help secure the area, coordinate with emergency responders, and lead evacuation procedures.

  • Ongoing Training & Certification Maintain required certifications in legal procedures, defensive tactics, CPR/AED, and first aid. Regular training ensures readiness and proficiency with all assigned equipment.

title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.

AES has been ranked #1 by BloombergNEF in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for millions of people worldwide.

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

We are seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst to join our Financial Reporting team. In this role, you will contribute to the preparation and analysis of financial statements and disclosures in compliance with U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external auditors, and cross-functional teams, gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting, reporting, and regulatory matters across AES's businesses.

This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your technical accounting expertise, expand your knowledge of the energy industry, and build strong partnerships across the organization while supporting critical financial reporting and compliance activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation, review, and submission of financial reporting deliverables as part of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, including trial balances, reporting packages, cash flow statements, management reports, disclosure checklists, representation letters, and subsequent event analyses.

  • Partner with external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits for AES consolidated financial statements and selected U.S. subsidiary audits.

  • Prepare and coordinate timely and accurate external filings required by legal agreements, regulatory requirements, and local reporting obligations.

  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of financial reporting procedures, documentation, metrics, and reporting processes.

  • Support quality control and review processes by maintaining appropriate documentation standards and sharing best practices across the team.

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business to develop operational knowledge and serve as a trusted resource for financial reporting and accounting matters.

  • Monitor emerging accounting guidance, SEC developments, and industry trends, and assist in evaluating their potential impact on AES.

  • Coordinate and support pre-close activities, including information gathering, meeting materials, agendas, and documentation as needed.

  • Assist in maintaining an effective internal control environment and supporting SOX compliance requirements related to financial reporting and disclosures.

  • Support the evaluation of technical accounting matters and help coordinate disclosure information required for quarterly and annual SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K.

  • Participate in the review and preparation of SEC filings for Indianapolis Power & Light Company and Dayton Power & Light Company.

  • Contribute to special projects and process improvement initiatives that enhance reporting efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • Knowledge of financial reporting principles and accounting standards, including U.S. GAAP.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and functions.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting financial reporting, external audits, SEC reporting, or regulatory compliance activities.

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance, internal controls, and financial disclosure processes.

  • Experience working with large organizations, public companies, or regulated industries.

  • CPA certification or progress toward certification is a plus.

  • Knowledge of SEC filing requirements and financial reporting systems.

title: Vice President, Global Workplace Design Lead
description:
About this role

Your Team

The Global Workplace Planning team is responsible for the strategic planning and execution of the firm’s corporate real estate strategy. This includes the strategic space planning, site acquisition and lease negotiation, design and construction and the ongoing management of the firms leases and rental payments. Within Workplace Planning, the Global Design & Construction (D & C) team is responsible for the planning and execution of capital projects, which includes requests for space alterations, renovation projects and fit out of new office locations. Additionally, D&C owns and implements global space and design standards for BlackRock offices.

Your Role and Impact

BlackRock has recently experienced significant headcount growth and transformed its workplace dramatically. From a new world-class headquarters in New York City to innovation hubs across the globe, we are building an organization focused on delivering a high-quality and consistent workplace experience at the firm.

The Workplace Design Lead has responsibility for BlackRock’s Global Workplace Design Standards and furniture programs. The position reports into the Global Head of Design and Construction (D&C) and will work closely with D&C Regional Leads and other functional leads within Workplace Planning.

You will be an ambassador and subject matter expert on the design and space standards, leading to bring consistency and functionality to support BlackRock’s flexible workplace. You are driven by design and creating workplaces for your colleagues that invite to connect and collaborate. You are able to build trusting relationships and use your influencing skills to implement practical solutions to achieve common objectives. You thrive on being challenged and finding solutions to complex problems, without losing the big picture. You align with BlackRock’s passion for technology and sustainability and champion these areas in the application of the design standards.

title: Manufacturing Planner III
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Manufacturing Planner III

Job Description Summary:

Manufacturing Engineering Planners write detailed work instructions in support of factory operations and contributing to hands on assistance at the shop floor utilizing schedules, parts, tools, engineering designs and processes to ensure a robust, reproducible and repeatable build plan that provides configuration control to the product. Manufacturing Planners ensure that engineering requirements are incorporated into the build from a hands on technical prospective and ensure production data can be properly recorded and non-conformance dispositions are released and can be worked. This function also provides manufacturing shop assistance, ship side support and build plan support. More senior levels help develop build plan at the cell and factory level.

Job Description:

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

As part of a diverse and hardworking team of experts you will directly support program execution for Manufacturing Engineering for the New Glenn orbital launch vehicle. As a Manufacturing Planner, you will provide training and support for Manufacturing Engineering processes which utilize system tools, including mBOM creation, change notice submittal, work order authoring, engineering change implementation, nonconformance processing, BOM reconciliation, and work order execution. You will also be responsible for providing oversight for the creation and maintenance of manufacturing plans and authoring and executing work orders for outplant processing. In addition you will maintain and communicate manufacturing engineering metrics and schedules.

The company celebrates strong collaboration, unique and innovative solutions, and passion for success. We are searching for a proactive, service-oriented individual with excellent oral, written and interpersonal skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment to positively impact safe human spaceflight.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!.

Responsibilities:

  • Leads at the cell level the development, implementation, and maintenance of various manufacturing plans, Bill of Materials, work instructions, and illustrations to define and document as-built configuration of major production hardware
  • Leads at the cell level the development and integration of suppliers, processes, materials, data, and technology to meet manufacturing and delivery requirements.
  • Leads the reviewing of supplier data to ensure manufacturing-related requirements are met.
  • Develops tooling requirements and initiates tooling orders based on manufacturing and engineering requirements.
  • Leads tooling dispositions.
  • Leads the Investigation of and resolves manufacturing-related issues of a broad scope.
  • Participates in producibility assessments for part or product designs.
  • Provides input to design, manufacturing processes, and manufacturing technologies to meet costs and schedules at the cell level
  • Develops work statements and sequencing of events to support delivery commitments for major hardware.
  • Reviews, maintains and monitoring of internal documents and schedules
  • Provides shipside support
  • Functions as an individual contributor or as part of a cross functional team. Helps train junior teammates.

Required:

  • HS/GED/Equiv required. Associate Degree or trade school in related discipline and/or 7+ years of manufacturing planner, or production experience or a combination of education and experience
  • Understanding of Project Management, Lean Six Sigma or lean methods.
  • Intermediate experience with P6 or other GANTT-style project management tools
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired:

  • Strong technical knowledge in one or more disciplines
  • Expert understanding of GD&T
  • Ability to lead independent contributors and lead a cross functional team.
  • Expert with Manufacturing & CAD Software (Jules, CMES, Velocity, Enovia, Delmia, CATIA, CREO, Etc.)

title: Production Program Manager 2
description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is currently seeking an AARGM Production Program Manager to support the Advanced Weapons Business Unit located in Northridge, CA.

This position is required to be full-time, on-site in the Northridge, CA location. No remote/telework arrangement is available for this position. Applicants must have a current US Government Secret security clearance with ability to get cleared for SAP.

The Production Program Manager will lead and manage production of the Advanced Anti-Radiation Guided Missile (AARGM), an air-launched, counter-air-defense weapon system for U.S. and FMS customers. The Production Program Manager oversees production contract execution phases including: kick-off, planning, material procurement, manufacturing, and delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage DoD customer relationships

  • Measure and report program performance

  • Develop and brief executive level presentations to customer leadership, executive management, and other program stakeholders

  • Support the management of Intercompany Work Order (IWO) and Independent Suppliers to meet program objectives

  • Adhere to all internal processes, policies, and applicable industry standards

  • Support and at times lead the development and adherence to master plans and integrated master schedules

  • Conduct thorough risk & opportunity management practices including identification, mitigation and realization

  • Support and lead proposal preparation process as required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of program management experience OR a master’s degree and 6 years of program management experience.

  • 4+ years of managing production programs and leading high performing, cross-functional teams within the aerospace/defense sector

  • Experience leading the performance of tasks on schedule, at or under cost achieving all requirements as either a project lead, integrated program team lead, or cost account manager.

  • Experience with executive level power point presentations

  • Demonstrated competencies with risk, issues and opportunities

  • Management of firm fixed price (FFP) projects

  • Proficiency in project management tools and processes such as Earned Value Management System (EVMS), Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), and Risk and Opportunity Management.

  • Current US Government Secret security clearance with ability to get cleared for SAP

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A degree in science, engineering, or business

  • PMP® certification

  • Experience managing programs as the Prime Contractor for DoD systems

  • Experience in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.

  • Develop and maintain scheduled or background processes when required, using tools such as Quartz.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional backend software development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, preferably Java 17.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Hibernate or JPA-based persistence.
  • Proven experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable, and production-ready backend applications.
  • Experience with automated testing, debugging, and code review practices.
  • Ability to participate in technical design discussions and translate designs into working solutions.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Interest in and willingness to use AI-assisted development tools as part of the engineering workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing scheduled or background jobs using Quartz or similar libraries.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Kiro or comparable coding assistants.
  • Experience working in design-first or specification-driven development environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted applications. Experience with AWS, GCP, or another cloud platform is acceptable, but deep cloud infrastructure expertise is not required.
  • Experience supporting platforms related to automotive services, financing, e-commerce, or other transaction-based products.

AI-Assisted Development

The team follows a design-first development approach. Engineers create and refine the technical design before using AI agents to assist with implementation. The engineering team then reviews, validates, and improves the generated code.

Previous experience with Kiro is not required, but candidates should demonstrate genuine interest in adopting AI-assisted development tools and the ability to critically review AI-generated solutions.

title: Senior Associate, Asset Management - Brio India
description:
TITLE: Associate, Asset Management Brio India

DEPARTMENT: Brio Asset Management

REPORTS TO: VP, Asset Management Brio India

In 2025, Blackstone established Brio Real Estate (“Brio”) as a portfolio company focused on real estate credit. Brio is a specialized global commercial real estate asset services platform that manages and supports Blackstone’s Real Estate Debt Strategies business (“BREDS”) across the globe. Today, BREDS has more than $77 billion in investor capital across high yield / opportunistic real estate credit funds, a publicly traded Mortgage REIT, CMBS securities and insurance capital. Brio is a sophisticated real estate credit solutions provider that enhances value for investors and supports BREDS across key functions, including asset management, transactions, capital markets, surveillance, portfolio management and legal & compliance. Brio provides critical infrastructure and capabilities for BREDS to allow for effective investments and management of its global portfolio.

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Blackstone’s scale, with roughly 12,700 real estate assets and over 240 portfolio companies, enables them to invest in dynamic sectors positioned for long-term growth. The firm seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by building strong businesses that deliver lasting value. Blackstone’s global investment strategies focus on real estate, private equity, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, credit, secondaries and hedge funds.

JOB SUMMARY

  • Execute asset management strategies to ensure sound management and risk mitigation across the global commercial real estate debt portfolio;
  • Oversee the performance of all commercial real estate debt assets including assisting with monitoring loan performance, covenant compliance, capex tracking, IPD waterfall analysis, redemptions, prepayments, disposals, asset-level business plans, lease-up progress, borrower financials, quarterly loan reviews and on-going portfolio management workstreams;
  • Produce portfolio-wide analytics to support strategic decision-making and identify emerging trends

title: Sr. Manufacturing Systems Engineer (Automation Engineer)
description:
Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.   • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting Skills
  • AVEVA Wonderware Intouch configuration, programming, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management
  • Rockwell Automation PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, including programming and integration
  • Process automation for biopharmaceutical manufacturing equipment and utilities

  • Automation system commissioning, qualification, testing, and start-up support

  • Continuous-improvement methods focused on safety, reliability, throughput, efficiency, and sustainability

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Sr. Mfg Systems Engineer professional we seek is an individual contributor with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree in Engineering

Or

Master’s degree in Engineering and 2 years of Manufacturing Systems/Automation experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and 4 years of Manufacturing Systems/Automation experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting automation systems in a regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with the design, configuration, installation, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle support of automation systems.
  • Ability to support manufacturing operations, capital projects, and troubleshooting activities in an on-site production environment.

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

title: M03 - Senior Low-Code Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Enterprise Software Specialist (OutSystems) to design, develop and deliver secure, scalable enterprise applications using the OutSystems platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on application development, platform enhancement, integrations, migration and engineering best practices. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects and implementation partners throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement enterprise applications using OutSystems 11 (O11) and OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC), including Reactive Web Apps, Service Modules, Core Services, integrations and reusable UI components.
  • Develop and enhance enterprise applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities, including integration with AWS Bedrock models.
  • Maintain and support existing OutSystems applications, including production issue resolution, enhancements, release coordination and platform health monitoring.
  • Support the migration of applications from OutSystems 11 to ODC, including application assessment, dependency review, remediation, testing and migration readiness.
  • Configure and develop applications on ODC, covering application architecture, reusable components, integrations, deployment and development standards.
  • Translate business requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable OutSystems solutions while maximising reusable platform capabilities.
  • Develop reusable Blocks, Server Actions, Client Actions, APIs, integration patterns and shared service modules.
  • Integrate OutSystems with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, enterprise databases, AWS-hosted services and other enterprise platforms using REST APIs and secure authentication patterns.
  • Conduct technical reviews, mentor engineers and review implementation deliverables to ensure engineering quality and production readiness.
  • Evaluate new OutSystems capabilities and contribute to engineering standards, development guidelines, reusable patterns and release practices.
  • Ensure applications comply with enterprise security, architecture, accessibility, audit logging and data governance requirements.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of enterprise software engineering experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on OutSystems development experience, preferably with OutSystems 11 and/or ODC.
  • Experience delivering enterprise low-code web applications, document automation, AI/LLM-enabled solutions, integrations or productivity platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Product environments and collaborating with implementation partners, platform owners and technical architects.

Technical Skills

  • Strong OutSystems development experience covering Reactive Web Apps, Screens, Blocks, Client Actions, Server Actions, Entities, Aggregates, Advanced SQL, Timers, integrations and Exception Handling.
  • Strong understanding of OutSystems architecture patterns, including foundation modules, core services, end-user modules, producer-consumer dependencies, reusable components and application layering.
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, authorisation, role-based access control, SSO, identity integration and secure secrets management.
  • Experience implementing enterprise OutSystems applications involving document processing, AI/LLM integrations, AWS Bedrock and secure role-based access control would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of OutSystems Service Center, LifeTime, deployment planning, environment management, CI/CD, code review and DevSecOps practices.

Certifications

  • OutSystems Associate Reactive Developer certification or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • OutSystems Professional Developer or Tech Lead certification is highly desirable.
  • Additional certifications in cloud, DevSecOps, software architecture, security or Agile delivery are advantageous.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound judgement in balancing OutSystems platform capabilities, reusable solutions and custom development.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working across evolving business and technical requirements.

Summary:


Reports to the Nurse Manager but daily activities are coordinated by the charge nurse. Under direct supervision works with patient and family centered care teams to ensure all business functions related to processing patient information, managing documentation, organizing patient medical record and facilitating smooth unit operations. Files appropriate patient reports and other information for their records. Facilitates communication among staff, relaying messages/information. Facilitates bed management and patient throughput on unit. Performs functions necessary to process direct admissions to the unit. Acts as receptionist for visitors to unit and also as a business partner to the department and clinical staff. Orients patients and families to the unit, answering routine questions. Able to multitask.

Job Responsibilities:

1) Bed Management: Tracks, prioritizes and assigns beds. Communicates with BMD and BM for admissions, discharges and transfers (ADTs). Coordinates unit/department ADTs. Checks BMD enters new data and advises Charge Nurse of changes. Checks CIS for discharge orders, follows up with MD, CM RN to assure discharge documents are complete. Enters discharges in OA Gold and pending discharges in BMD. Rounds 3 times daily with RNs and CM regarding discharges, discharge times and special instructions, appropriateness for Discharge Lounge. Notifies CM if ambulance is unable to come @ assigned time. With CM, monitors BMD for observation patients to determine if patient needs discharge or status change. Tracks new admissions from the ED. Retrieves SBAR data from the ED and communicates to the nursing staff. Assures fax is received within 30 minutes. Arranges patient transport from the ED if needed. Carries BMD beeper, assigns coverage during breaks and meals to ensure constant flow of ADTs.

2) Proficiently and accurately utilizes the following computer applications in daily work: C Word, OA Gold, SMS, CIS, Premise, BMD, PCM Auditor, People Soft and Staples and Kronos access if applicable.

3) Unit specific projects: Project work as assigned and/or needed such as Payroll, committee participation, develop unit time schedules, etc.

4) Communication: provides report/handoff to next shift including pending discharges, admissions in process, empty beds, beds being cleaned, and closed beds with the reason. Contacts other departments for priority tests for patients identified for next day discharge. Answers telephones and relays messages promptly with consistent accuracy to team members. Responds to routine inquires knowledgeably and/or refers them to appropriate person, assists staff as requested, ensures identified problems are communicated accurately and promptly. Places calls to MD's and ancillary departments to facilitate patient care and throughput. Where appropriate, coordinates communication with NEOPO and related paperwork in conjunction with RN. Screen calls for clinical team and facilitates communication of information requested.

5) Serve as a unit-based resource for Zoned Hospitalist and medical/surgical teaching teams. Assist Hospitalist during clinical rounds, i.e. initiate phone calls, send faxes and call consults as directed by Zoned Hospitalist. Make available the unit-based assignment (RN/Case Manager/Social Worker as well as covering RNs [i.e. lunch and breaks]) daily for Hospitalist. Maintain and identify specific workspace for Hospitalists which include computer and telephone access. Works with Access Services and patient/family to secure post discharge follow-up appointments. Identifies daily the Hospitalist of the day through electronic systems and prints this form for team use throughout the day. Posts break and lunch coverage in a central location for ease in obtaining patient related information and fostering communication.

6) Functions as a greeter for the arrival of new patients/families to the unit/department. Assists other departments with information and or answers to questions as requested.

7) Hospital Records and logs:
Maintains patient chart in proper sequence and labels pages with patient's name. Prepares record prior to transfer and discharge. Explains and obtains signatures for Medicare forms. Organizes chart for Medical Records, faxes or copies records as needed. Sends discharge record to HIM (old and new) immediately after discharge. Updates discharge/admission log. Ensures complete information is sent with transfers. Prepares patient charge ticket for data entry and keeps accurate record on unit. When appropriate, enter data into PCM auditor at specified times. Replenish and restock unit audit tools (i.e. refrigerator logs, negative pressure room logs, etc.). Other unit logs i.e. assignment books, sick call records, Kronos variance forms, etc.

8) Unit Resource: Post/file MD schedules for clinical team inquiry. In coordination with charge nurse, prepare staffing assignment for the next shift. Place calls to replace unplanned staffing vacancies. communicate staffing and scheduling to Clinical Supervisor. As needed, but not limited to obtain mail from the mailroom, blood products from the Laboratory, medications from Pharmacy and supplies from Distribution and Dietary as needed.

9) Inventories, maintains and charges supplies. Initiates requisitions and requests accurately and in a timely fashion. Stores supplies within 24 hours of receipt in designated area. Records or submits charges and/or credits for patient supplies as needed. Coordinate paper supplies with Print Shop and/or Distribution to maintain unit/department par levels.

10) Is knowledgeable of and initiates emergency procedures as needed/directed within unit/department. Verbalizes knowledge and location of emergency equipment. Mobilizes emergency support personnel through immediate telephone contact.

We strive to be the place where we can help you build the career you deserve – apply with your resume today – YOU belong at Baystate!

Education:

title: Scientific Associate Director, Human Disease Biology, Inflammation Research
description:
Career Category

Scientific

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Scientific Associate Director, Human Disease Biology, Inflammation Research

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will work at the intersection of disease biology, multi-omic profiling, computational analysis, and drug discovery, generating insights that advance therapeutic opportunities in respiratory, dermatologic, and/or rheumatologic diseases.

The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in human disease biology with experience translating discoveries into therapeutic hypotheses and drug discovery programs. They will serve as a scientific leader who integrates data across human genetics, transcriptomics, proteomics, spatial biology, and single-cell technologies to identify disease mechanisms, patient subsets, biomarkers, and novel therapeutic opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a disease-focused discovery strategy leveraging multi-omic and human data to deepen mechanistic understanding of respiratory, dermatologic, or rheumatologic diseases.

  • Continuous adoption of technology, AI/computation and innovation to improve efficiency and quality of work. Integration of systems immunology, multi-omics, AI-enabled biology, and human disease research to bring unique insights and innovative approaches to Amgen's discovery efforts.

  • Lead cross-functional scientific initiatives that integrate human genetics, single-cell biology, spatial biology, proteomics, and computational analyses to identify and validate first/best-in-class therapeutic targets, patient segments and biomarker strategies.

  • Drive generation and interpretation of multimodal datasets and translate findings into actionable hypotheses for target discovery and program prioritization/advancement.

  • Partner closely with computational biology, translational sciences, human genetics, pathology, and disease-area biology teams to build integrated disease models and prioritize therapeutic opportunities.

  • Serve as a scientific leader for disease-focused discovery efforts and provide expertise in human tissue biology, disease pathogenesis, and emerging technologies.

  • Design and oversee internal and external collaborations with academic investigators, clinical researchers, consortia, and technology partners.

  • Contribute to advancement of programs through target validation, indication selection, biomarker identification, and patient stratification strategies.

  • Mentor scientists and foster rigorous, collaborative, and innovative scientific practices across project teams.

  • Leads multiple cross-functional projects and scientific initiatives focused on disease understanding and target discovery.

  • Influences the direction of several discovery programs through generation of disease insights and translational hypotheses.

  • Serves as a recognized expert in disease biology and multi-omic analysis within the department.

  • Contributes to departmental strategy related to human biology, disease understanding, and technology deployment.

  • Builds productive collaborations across research functions and external scientific communities.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Director we seek is an accomplished leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree PhD

OR

PharmD

OR

MD [and relevant post-doc where applicable] and 4 years of relevant scientific experience

OR

Master’s degree and 7 years of relevant scientific experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of relevant scientific experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Significant experience in both academic research and biopharmaceutical drug discovery.
  • Experience integrating human genetics, transcriptomics, proteomics, single-cell, spatial, imaging, and clinical datasets to generate actionable biological insights that inform target validation, biomarker strategies, patient stratification approaches, and drug discovery programs.
  • Strong understanding of the drug discovery and development process, including target identification, validation, translational strategy, and preclinical development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead matrixed teams and build productive collaborations across scientific disciplines.
  • Record of scientific achievement as evidenced by high-impact publications, presentations, patents, external collaborations, or contributions to advancing therapeutic programs.
  • Curiosity-driven scientist with a passion for understanding human disease biology and leveraging emerging technologies to accelerate discovery.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence scientific strategy across diverse stakeholders.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

description:

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

The Salt Lake City Remote Operating Control Center (ROCC) is currently seeking a Control Room Operator to remotely monitor the operation of a large renewable asset portfolio across various regions, particularly, CAISO and WECC. The current portfolio is diverse, comprised of Wind, Solar, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), and Solar + Battery systems. Under limited supervision of a Control Room Team Lead, Control Room Operator will monitor and control electronic computer and peripheral electronic data processing equipment to process data and remotely operate wind turbine generators, solar sites and battery systems.

The successful candidate will have experience in control room operations, the power industry, record of working rotating/swing shifts, and demonstrated ability to work in high performing teams under limited supervision.

This position involves remotely monitoring and operating generation units in various states from our ROCC located in Salt Lake City, UT.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of a growing fleet of utility-scale solar, wind, and BESS assets
  • Monitor portfolio via SCADA system for asset faults, errors, alarms, site underperformance and notify/dispatch appropriate parties if faults cannot be reset/cleared.
  • Adjust plant operating parameters (Real Power Generation, Voltage, Power Factor) as directed by the Balancing Authority, Transmission Operator, and Operations Management.
  • Make required operational reports to various grid entities (Reliability Coordinator, Transmission Operator, Balancing Authority, Scheduling Coordinators).
  • Communicate with and dispatch field O&M personnel for troubleshooting site equipment.
  • Coordinate outage support and energy isolation with field O&M personnel and TOP.
  • Develop and manage outage schedules and forecasting activities.
  • Interact frequently with cross-functional teams across the AES organization and with other external organizations.
  • Create and track corrective maintenance tickets, with prior experience using SAP.
  • Contribute to the development of plant-specific operating procedures incorporating all requirements from NERC, PPA’s, IA’s and relevant Functional Entities.
  • Assist in the onboarding and integration of new generation assets.
  • Contribute to a strict culture of regulatory compliance.
  • Obtain and maintain certifications that may be needed for further Control Center needs (i.e., NERC or PJM Certification). Not currently required.
  • Participate in safety activities including weather monitoring and routine & emergency response communications.
  • Interact with customers on issues related to asset performance and reliability.
  • Record information such as fault time, fault code, and operational actions taken while on shift.
  • Maintain logbooks within compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2+ years’ experience in control center operations, preferably in utility scale renewable energy assets
  • 3-5 years in the Power Generation Industry (Power Plant or Renewable Operations, I&C, Field Maintenance, Electrician, Power Plant operations, or Military Operations)
  • Familiarity with electrical substation safety protocol, equipment, and operations
  • Familiarity with NERC standards and impact on operations (VAR, COM, EOP, PER, PRC, TOP)
  • Competency in plant processes, electrical and SCADA systems
  • Ability to strictly follow operating procedures, without exception
  • Familiarity with the maintenance and operations of solar, wind, and Battery Energy Storage generation assets
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to manage critical situations
  • Willingness to undergo regular training to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant operations
  • Reliable, punctual and capable of being trusted with significant taskings while maintaining integrity while unsupervised
  • Ability to thrive within a small, agile and fast-growing team
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills
  • High level proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Teams)
  • Able to work effectively under pressure with multiple priorities.
  • Ability to function in a high-paced environment
  • Ability to remain calm and collective during stressful situations
  • Experience with documentation control systems: SharePoint, Docushare, SAP, etc.
  • Experience creating, editing and documenting Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS).
  • Ability to make independent decisions, adapt to responsibility, and follow direct instructions.
  • Must be able to work a rotating 12-hour shift schedule.
  • Must have experience with data acquisition and SCADA.
  • Ability to establish trust through building relationships and demonstration of capabilities.
  • Familiarity with LOTO practices, Electric Switchgear switching, & Electrical Isolations experience preferred.
  • Good safety awareness & practices

title: Platform and Services Engineer - IAM  (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds and London)
description:

Are you an Engineer who is passionate about Identity and Access Management, automation, AWS cloud technology, and solving complex engineering challenges?

At Genomics England, we're hiring an IAM Platform and Services Engineer.

This role sits in our high impact Business Systems Team within our Scalable Tech service, working alongside systems administration, cloud platform and IAM engineering specialists. Together, the service provides underpinning infrastructure and guard rails to stream aligned teams across our healthcare and research services.

The IAM Platform and Services Engineer collaborates across Business Systems, Security, Information Governance, Architecture, Software, QA and Platform engineering specialists to design, build and maintain enterprise-wide solutions for Identity and Access Management (IAM) / Authentication, Authorisation and Accountability (AAA).

As an Engineer in the team, you will also be expected to contribute to the Engineering Chapter through enablement, coaching and strategy, working closely with your team and the wider engineering community across the business to help Genomics England build a future-ready cloud platform that will stand the test of time.

This is an engineering role in a truly mission-critical environment, ensuring our platforms are scalable, secure, and efficient. Your knowledge and expertise will really shape the future of our technology; we believe strongly in empowering engineers, fostering an inclusive culture, and giving you the autonomy to make a real impact.

Everyday responsibilities include:

  • Design, implement, operate and continuously improve identity and access management policies, processes and controls to ensure access to IT and information resources is managed and controlled effectively and securely, operating within legal and regulatory constraints and meeting business requirements.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)

  • Authentication and Authorisation

  • Identity Lifecycle Management

  • Integration and Interoperability of solutions within the hybrid cloud and on prem Infrastructure, demonstrating expertise and engineering best practice in respect of infrastructure as code, automation, orchestration, CI/CD, configuration management and a collaborative DevOps culture

  • Security, Information Governance and Compliance

  • Provide both proactive and reactive operational support, minimising need where possible and simplifying delivery through effective logging, monitoring and knowledge transfer

  • Collaborate with a supportive DevOps team to drive automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • Provide support to fellow Platform Engineers with day-to-day changes to our codebase.

  • Develop and maintain Engineering Golden Path templates and contribute to engineering enablement across the wider organisation.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate deployments and reduce manual effort.

  • Influence engineering decisions in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives.

Skills and experience for success:

  • Solid expertise in IAM with demonstrable understanding of one or more industry standard IAM protocols, such as Kerberos, OAuth, FIDO, SCIM, LDAP, SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC)

  • Experience building and maintaining solutions for authentication, authorisation and accountability (AAA).

  • Knowledge of, and hands-on experience with, industry standard IAM tooling solutions, such as Okta, Auth0, Active Directory and Azure AD (MS Entra ID)

  • Some experience administering user access to networks and systems is desirable, including managing user access credentials, maintaining access in line with authorised service requests, and supporting joiner, mover and leaver processes.

  • Willingness to learn new skills and technology is a must

If you are an experienced and passionate IAM Platform and Services Engineer, we'd love to hear from you. Join Genomics England and help shape the platforms that are powering the future of genomic healthcare!

  • Qualifications are not mandatory. However, Okta certifications are welcomed and would be considered an advantage.

Summary
