title: Inventory Specialist II
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

As part of a small, passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will be responsible for facilitating the flow of aerospace hardware and equipment to and from various work centers or departments for various spaceflight systems. This scope will require detailed coordination with cross functional teams to ensure accurate compliance with work orders and efficient movement of parts, materials, consumables, tooling and equipment in support of manufacturing. You will share in the team’s impact on all aspects of manufacturing and production. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordination with all applicable Blue Origin departments to ensure on-time delivery of raw material, parts, consumables and tooling to and from the appropriate work centers
  • Enforce completion of work center buyoffs prior to moving hardware to the next work center
  • Ensure hardware and equipment are properly staged for inter-plant transportation/movement
  • Cross-reference and confirm part quantity, part number, serial number, labeling and routing sheet persist with hardware throughout plant movements
  • Ensure inventory movements are properly transacted and accurate
  • Contribute to zero-defect philosophy by escalating observed non-conformance or design/manufacturing issues that deviate from the nominal process
  • Support inventory deviation investigations found within work centers
  • Participate in production meetings to communicate part status information to management/leadership
  • Ensure smooth and efficient process flow by contributing to development/refinement of queuing software
  • Resolve past due invoice, receiving corrections and blind receipts

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of high school diploma or GED or equivalent experience
  • Forklift experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs. unassisted
  • Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position
  • Willingness to utilize powered lifting equipment, jib, crane or hoists
  • Must be open to working all required shift hours, including overtime and weekends, as needed

Desired:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • Strong computer skills, familiar with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc
  • Experience with MRP/ERP systems (Oracle, SAP, etc)
  • Prior experience within the aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronic industries
  • Experience in organizing files and documents
  • Past due invoice resolution

WA applicants is $31.11 - $43.54

Other site ranges may differ

Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

title: Core Operations - Officer
description:
Who we are looking for

We are looking for an individual with good Custody knowledge and a proven track record of dealing with and managing large client relationships in the Custody Department. . Knowledge of financial products, Financial markets, Custody Operations (including market settlements, Global payments, Corporate events, Global sub custody networks) is required. The candidate should be client focused, organised, possess a strong work ethic. Working as part of a dedicated client Custody Management team the candidate should be experienced in all aspects of Client management while ensuring that State Streets Ethical, Compliance and Risk Mangement principals are at all times adhered to

The role requires experience working in a highly matrixed environment and a good understanding of all aspects of operational perspectives.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a key part of State Street Global Delivery (SSGD) organisation
SSGD gives Global asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGD’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

The CMS Officer is responsible for supporting the delivery of high-quality custody services to assigned institutional clients, acting as a key coordination point between clients, investment managers, operations, and internal and external support functions. The role combines client service, operational oversight, issue resolution, risk management, and service governance responsibilities to ensure the consistent delivery of custody services in accordance with State Street's control framework and client service standards.

The successful candidate will develop strong client relationships, monitor operational performance, identify and escalate risks, and drive timely resolution of service issues while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Client Service and Relationship Management

  • Strong team player who can work on own initiative with minimum supervision
  • Act as a primary contact for designated Global custody clients and investment managers.
  • Manage day-to-day client service inquiries and operational escalations.
  • Coordinate responses in a timely manner across operations, asset servicing, settlements, cash processing, onboarding, fund accounting, and other support teams.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, internal stakeholders, and service delivery teams.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of client service reviews and governance meetings.

Governance and Reporting

  • Prepare management information, service dashboards, and client reporting packs.
  • Support internal governance forums and client service governance meetings.
  • Maintain accurate records of service issues, action items, and client commitments.
  • Contribute to KPI, KRI, and service performance reporting.
  • Assist with regulatory, audit, and compliance activities relating to custody servicing.

New Business and Change Management

  • Support onboarding of new funds, clients, and investment managers.
  • Participate in operational readiness activities for new products, markets, and regulatory initiatives.
  • Assist with testing, implementation, and communication activities associated with system and process enhancements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, client experience, and risk management.
  • Participate in process reviews and improvement initiatives.
  • Support automation and simplification of manual processes where appropriate.
  • Contribute to the enhancement of CMS procedures, controls, and best practices.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • University Degree or equivalent experience,
  • 5- 7 years of experience in the Banking and Financial Services business
  • Strong understanding of operational processes across all aspects of Global Custody

About State Street

What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Senior Mining Engineer
description:
The purpose of the Senior Mining Engineer is to lead and deliver integrated mining technical services across LoM planning, 3MRS, studies and Resource & Reserve reporting, ensuring accurate, optimised and execution-ready mining outputs aligned to the integrated business plan. The role is responsible for integrating mining plans developed in Deswik with project execution schedules, ensuring alignment between mine planning activities, care and maintenance requirements, asset preservation strategies and project delivery objectives.

The role is accountable for mining technical inputs into studies, project optimisation and value engineering, ensuring alignment between geological, operational and project planning requirements. The role ensures that mining activities, project work packages, preservation activities and operational readiness requirements are fully integrated within the overall execution schedule.

Typical Tasks

Safety, Legal Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all mining planning activities comply with safety and regulatory standards.

  • Identify and manage technical risks related to mining plans and assumptions.

  • Ensure alignment with mine safety, planning and operational requirements.

  • Maintain adherence to governance and reporting frameworks.

LoM Planning & Mining Technical Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrated Life of Mine plans, production schedules, mining sequences and development strategies using Deswik.

  • Ensure alignment between mining plans, project scope, preservation requirements and future operational objectives.

  • Translate strategic objectives into practical and executable mining plans and schedules.

  • Integrate mine plans with project execution schedules to ensure alignment of critical activities, milestones and resource requirements.

  • Structure mine planning outputs to support integration into Primavera P6 and other project scheduling systems.

  • Support the integration of mining, engineering, construction and operational readiness requirements into a single execution framework.

Project Planning & Schedule Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrated schedules combining mining activities, care and maintenance requirements, preservation activities and project execution work.

  • Convert Deswik mine plans into project execution schedules and work packages suitable for implementation and progress tracking.

  • Coordinate schedule interfaces between mining, engineering, construction, commissioning and operational readiness functions.

  • Support development and maintenance of integrated project schedules within Primavera P6 or equivalent project scheduling systems.

  • Monitor schedule performance and identify potential impacts arising from mining constraints, access limitations, preservation requirements or project changes.

  • Support critical path analysis, schedule risk assessments and recovery planning initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Project Controls teams to ensure schedule quality, forecasting accuracy and alignment with business delivery objectives.

3MRS & Development Planning

  • Lead development and coordination of 3MRS planning activities and outputs.

  • Align development priorities with Life of Mine strategy, project requirements and operational readiness plans.

  • Ensure integration of development schedules with infrastructure, preservation and project execution plans.

  • Evaluate alternative mining and project sequencing scenarios to maximise value and operational flexibility.

  • Support optimisation of development strategies to improve execution efficiency and project outcomes.

Studies & Technical Inputs

  • Provide mining technical inputs into concept, pre-feasibility, feasibility, execution and operational readiness studies.

  • Provide technical support to care and maintenance programmes, preservation initiatives and future restart planning activities.

  • Ensure mining assumptions, constraints and planning parameters are accurately reflected within studies and project documentation.

  • Undertake trade-off studies, scenario evaluations and mining optimisation analyses.

  • Develop planning assumptions, productivity models and execution strategies to support project evaluations and investment decisions.

  • Align study outputs with operational feasibility, execution requirements and business objectives.

Resource & Reserve Reporting

  • Coordinate and ensure accurate Resource and Reserve reporting.

  • Align mining plans and schedules with declared Resource and Reserve positions.

  • Ensure compliance with reporting standards, governance requirements and technical assurance processes.

  • Integrate geological, survey, geotechnical and planning inputs into reporting outputs.

  • Support reporting requirements associated with studies, project planning and business planning processes.

Project Optimisation & Value Engineering

  • Identify and drive optimisation opportunities across mining plans and project scope.

  • Challenge assumptions related to mining methods, sequencing and productivity.

  • Contribute to value engineering initiatives across studies and project phases.

  • Support capital efficiency and lifecycle value optimization.

Technical Assurance & Decision Support

  • Provide technical assurance on mining plans, schedules and study outputs.

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness and quality of mining deliverables.

  • Support preparation of decision-ready outputs for planning and project teams.

  • Clearly articulate mining risks, constraints and assumptions.

Stakeholder & Interface Management

  • Act as the primary mining interface between technical services, project controls, engineering, operations and project teams.

  • Lead multidisciplinary planning initiatives involving mining, engineering, geology, geotechnical, survey, preservation and project stakeholders.

  • Coordinate consultant and contractor activities to ensure delivery of planning, study and project requirements.

  • Facilitate integrated planning workshops and technical review sessions.

  • Influence stakeholders to achieve alignment on technical solutions, priorities, schedules and project objectives.

  • Coordinate inputs across multiple functions where no direct reporting relationship exists.

  • Drive accountability for mining-related deliverables through effective stakeholder engagement and technical leadership.

  • Grade 12 / Equivalent NQF Level 4 qualification.

  • Degree in Mining Engineering.

  • Professional registration (advantageous).

  • Valid driver’s licence.

Experience & Knowledge required:

  • 8-15 years' experience in mining technical services, mine planning, studies and project environments.

  • Demonstrated experience in Life of Mine planning, mine scheduling and mining optimisation.

  • Experience integrating mining plans with project execution schedules.

  • Experience within care and maintenance, brownfield project, operational readiness or asset preservation environments.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting project studies, project execution and capital projects.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary stakeholders, consultants and contractors without direct reporting authority.

  • Experience in underground mining operations and technical project environments.

Proven experience in:

  • 3MRS, studies and technical project environments.

  • Resource and Reserve reporting and integration.

Strong working knowledge of:

  • Deswik planning and scheduling systems.

  • Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project.

  • Mining planning methodologies and operational constraints.

  • Project Controls principles and schedule management practices.

  • Care and maintenance strategies and asset preservation principles.

  • Mining project development and stage-gate delivery processes.

  • Resource and Reserve reporting requirements and governance frameworks.

Our Values

Put Safety First

We consider all risks to people and the environment before proceeding with any activity. We address risks before beginning any activity, even if this means stopping a task. Zero Harm is always our goal.

Be Passionate

We are exhilarated by the product we sell, the challenges we face and the opportunities we create.

Pull Together

Being united in purpose and action, we will turn the diversity of our people, skills and experience into an unparalleled source of strength.

Build Trust

We will always listen first, then act with openness, honesty and integrity so that our relationships flourish

Show we Care

The people whose lives we touch, their communities, nations and the environment we share, all matter deeply to us. We will always think through the consequences of what we do so that our contribution to the world is real, lasting and makes us proud.

Shape the Future

We will find new ways. We will set demanding targets and take both tough decisions and considered risks to achieve them. We will insist on excellent execution and reward those who deliver.

This includes SOPs, manuals, user guides, checklists, process maps and operational communications.

You'll work across a broad range of range of Freight operations, gather and translating technical, regulatory and operational requirements into practical documentation. This includes identifying gaps, resolving conflicting inputs and constructively challenging existing practices to achieve compliant, efficient and workable outcomes.

Success in this role means applying operational insight and professional judgement to deliver controlled documentation that teams can understand, trust and confidently apply.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop, review and maintain controlled operational processes, SOPs, manuals, user guides, checklists and communications.
  • Work with SMEs and process owners to understand existing practices and document clear, compliant and practical ways of working.
  • Validate relevant operational, safety, regulatory and business requirements.
  • Coordinate document consultation, review, approval, publication and version-control activities.
  • Work with publication partner to ensure documents meet standards and formatting requirements.
  • Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies and process-improvement opportunities.
  • Tailor content for different audiences, with a strong focus on frontline clarity and usability.
  • Monitor feedback and operational change to keep documentation current and fit for purpose.
  • Support operational notices, process maps and training-impact identification where required.

You’ll have:

  • Experience within freight, logistics, aviation or another operationally focused environment.
  • Experience developing business processes, SOPs or other controlled documentation.
  • Strong written communication and editing skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate complex operational information into practical documentation.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • A practical approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity of thought, background and experience, and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, and people from all cultural backgrounds. If you require any support or adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please let us know at the time of application.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel:

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – apply today!

title: Insurance Data Engineer – Price Data
description:
Insurance Data Engineer – Price Data

Om stillingen

Som Insurance Data Engineer i prismotorteamet får du en sentral rolle i utviklingen og forvaltningen av data som brukes til operativ prising i Storebrand Forsikrings prismotor. Du blir en del av Team Prismotor og arbeider tett med systemutviklere, teknologer, prisanalytikere og andre forsikringsfaglige miljøer.

Du får ansvar for dataprodukter og datapipelines som inngår direkte i prismotorens løpende prisprosesser, både for nysalg og fornyelse. Løsningene er forretningskritiske og stiller høye krav til datakvalitet, sporbarhet, stabilitet og effektiv behandling. Du vil arbeide gjennom hele dataflyten, fra rådata i interne og eksterne kilder til produksjonssatte, dokumenterte og gjenbrukbare dataprodukter.

De samme dataene skal også kunne brukes til pris- og risikoanalyse. En viktig del av rollen er derfor å utvikle løsninger som ivaretar både operative og analytiske behov, med konsistente data, definisjoner og forretningsregler på tvers av bruksområdene.

Du vil arbeide med store og komplekse dataprodukter som inneholder betydelig forretningslogikk. Rollen krever at du kan sette deg inn i prisfaglige problemstillinger, omsette dem til robuste tekniske løsninger og bidra aktivt når kravene må konkretiseres eller utfordres. Du vil arbeide med et bredt spekter av interne og eksterne data knyttet til blant annet kunder, forsikringsobjekter, produkter, risiko og skadehistorikk, for eksempel

  • kjøretøydata fra TFF og OFV

  • bygnings- og eiendomsdata

  • intern skadehistorikk

  • kunde-, polise-, skade- og produktdata

  • data om fornyelse, prisendringer og kundeatferd

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • utvikle og forvalte datapipelines og dataprodukter for operativ prising i prismotor, både for nysalg og fornyelse

  • sikre at prismotoren har tilgang til korrekte, stabile og oppdaterte data

  • følge løsningene fra utvikling til produksjon og bidra med feilsøking, forbedringer og teknisk forvaltning

  • foredle, integrere og sammenstille rådata fra interne og eksterne kilder til ferdige dataprodukter

  • legge til rette for at operative og analytiske løsninger bygger på konsistente data, definisjoner og forretningsregler

  • samarbeide tett med prisanalytikere om utvikling og forvaltning av prisdata

  • bistå med å beskrive og omsette kompleks forretningslogikk til effektive, forståelige og testbare transformasjoner

  • arbeide med teknologier som Snowflake, dbt, Databricks og PostgreSQL

  • bidra til gode utviklingsprosesser, automatisert testing, dokumentasjon og høy kodekvalitet, samt etablere og forvalte automatiserte datakvalitetskontroller, overvåking og varsling for kritiske dataflyter

  • utfordre etablerte løsninger og påvirke tekniske valg

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen informatikk, datateknologi, programvareutvikling eller et tilsvarende fagområde. Relevant og omfattende arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning.

Du har solid erfaring med data engineering, datavarehus, dataprodukter eller andre dataorienterte løsninger. Du har utviklet løsninger med høy kompleksitet og stor betydning for virksomheten, og er vant til å ta ansvar for mer enn selve implementeringen.

Det er viktig at du har erfaring med data som skal fungere i operativ produksjon. Du forstår konsekvensene av datakvalitetsfeil, endringer i kildedata og utilstrekkelig sporbarhet, og bygger løsninger som kan forvaltes og videreutvikles over tid.

Samtidig forstår du analytiske behov og kunne utvikle datagrunnlag som er egnet for analyse, modellering og oppfølging. Du kan se sammenhengen mellom den operative bruken av data og hvordan de samme dataene senere brukes til å vurdere pris, risiko og lønnsomhet.

Vi ser etter en person som:

  • har gode ferdigheter i SQL og erfaring med utvikling av komplekse datatransformasjoner

  • har erfaring med moderne verktøy og plattformer for databehandling og datamodellering

  • har god forståelse for programvareutvikling, versjonskontroll, testing og produksjonssetting

  • kan ta eierskap til tekniske løsninger og drive relevante tekniske beslutninger

  • kan sette seg inn i omfattende forretningslogikk og gjøre den eksplisitt, testbar og vedlikeholdbar

  • evner å tilpasse arbeidsmetodikk og tekniske løsninger når operative hensyn og forretningsbehov tilsier det

  • kan balansere kortsiktige leveransebehov mot langsiktig kvalitet og forvaltbarhet

Erfaring fra finans- eller forsikringsbransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Erfaring med prising, risikomodellering eller andre regel- og datatunge domener vil også være relevant.

Personlige egenskaper

Du tar eierskap til løsningene du arbeider med, også etter at de er satt i produksjon. Du arbeider selvstendig når det er nødvendig, men involverer relevante fagpersoner når problemstillinger må avklares på tvers av teknologi, data og forretning.

Du er analytisk og kvalitetsorientert, men samtidig pragmatisk. Du klarer å skille mellom krav som faktisk er nødvendige, etablerte antakelser som bør utfordres, og tekniske mønstre som ikke passer problemet som skal løses.

Du kommuniserer presist med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske fagmiljøer.

Hvorfor søke?

Storebrand satser kraftig i forsikringsdomenet, og spesielt innenfor prising. Du blir med i et team med dyktige og engasjerte kolleger. Løsningene du utvikler har direkte betydning for prisene kundene møter, og du får betydelig påvirkning på hvordan kritiske prisdata og tekniske løsninger utformes, forvaltes og videreutvikles.

Hvorfor velge Storebrand?

Hos oss får du rom til å ta plass, bli hørt og utvikle deg i et konsern med mange muligheter. Vi er stolte av kulturen vår, drivkraften vår og den felles retningen vi jobber mot: En fremtid å glede seg til.

Vi tror på verdien av ulike perspektiver og bakgrunner, og jobber aktivt for et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø. Det blir lagt merke til: I 2025 rangerte Equileap Storebrand som nummer én i Norge og blant de tre beste selskapene i verden på likestilling. I 2026 vant vi ODA Champions.

Som fremtidsoptimister tenker vi langsiktig og investerer i løsninger som styrker oss og samfunnet rundt oss. Det er én grunn til at vi er ett av to norske selskaper i Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index.

Hos oss på Lysaker jobber du sentralt, med gode kollektivmuligheter, sykkelparkering og garderober. Du får helseforsikring, tilgang til kiropraktor og fysioterapeut på kontoret, og gode treningsmuligheter i Storebrand Arena. I tillegg tilbyr vi en meget god pensjonsordning, gunstige forsikringer og boliglån med subsidiert rente.

Har du spørsmål rundt stillingen? Kontakt Leder prismotor, Johan Benum Evensberget (johan.benum.evensberget@storebrand.no)

Søknadsfrist 04.10.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Å søke jobb i Storebrand skal være enkelt. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive et søknadsbrev. Vi ønsker kun din CV og svar på noen få spørsmål i søknadsprosessen.


Vi tror på at mangfold styrker oss, og ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere uansett bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen. Trenger du tilpasninger i søknadsprosessen? Ikke nøl med å gi oss beskjed – slik at vi sammen kan finne en løsning som fungerer for deg.


Storebrand samarbeider med Semac for bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. I forbindelse med bakgrunnssjekk må politiattest fremlegges for stillinger som krever autorisasjon og/eller godkjenning av egnethet.

title: (Junior) Consultant - AST National (m/w/d)
description:

Was Dich auszeichnet

title: Risk Officer
description:
About the role

We are growing our Risk and Compliance team and seeking two Risk Officers to strengthen our capability across risk assessment, controls assurance and business resilience.

RWWA’s racing and sports wagering activities offer varied and challenging risk work in a highly regulated industry. Our responsibilities include supporting the development and long-term sustainability of WA’s racing industry, safeguarding racing integrity and animal welfare, and meeting obligations relating to responsible wagering, anti-money laundering and privacy. This is an opportunity to apply your skills and develop broader risk expertise while helping shape RWWA’s risk practices as we build our capability and maturity.

Reporting to the Risk and Compliance Team Lead, you will share business partnering responsibilities with colleagues in the risk team. Alongside this shared work, there is scope to lead specific areas of controls assurance or business resilience. In this second line role, you will provide advice, oversight and constructive challenge to business owners, who remain accountable for managing their risks.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Partner with business owners to assess risks, review incidents and issues, monitor agreed actions and escalate significant matters.
  • Develop and deliver risk-based control testing plans, assess control design and operating effectiveness, document findings and recommend practical improvements.
  • Assess business disruption impacts and critical dependencies, and work with business owners to develop continuity plans and recovery strategies. Maintain crisis arrangements, coordinate exercises and support crisis response, using lessons learned to strengthen resilience.
  • Work with business users to identify information and reporting needs, and help develop and maintain workflows, reports and dashboards in Protecht, our online governance, risk and compliance (GRC) system. Keep risk and control information accurate through data entry, validation and updates.
  • Provide practical advice and training, and improve risk frameworks, tools and guidance.

About you

We welcome applications from experienced risk professionals looking to broaden their expertise and professionals seeking to move into risk from disciplines such as accounting and finance, business analysis, technology, engineering, governance, projects or operations. You will bring a track record of delivering practical outcomes in a professional setting and demonstrate the following capabilities.

What you will bring

  • An understanding of risk management principles and processes, with the ability to apply them to practical business situations.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking, including the ability to understand complex processes, recognise dependencies and assess their implications for business objectives.
  • Sound judgement and practical problem solving, with the ability to evaluate evidence, challenge assumptions, identify underlying causes and recommend proportionate solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively with business systems, data and reporting, maintain accurate information, identify inconsistencies and communicate clear insights.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder engagement, including building trusted relationships, understanding different perspectives, explaining complex issues clearly and influencing stakeholders to act on practical recommendations.
  • Initiative, adaptability and accountability, including learning and applying new concepts, managing priorities and following through on agreed outcomes with integrity and professional discretion.

Desirable experience

Experience in risk management, controls assurance, compliance or business continuity would be valuable. Experience relevant to risk management may also come from audit, banking, finance, business analysis, projects, technology or operations. A background banking, financial services or another regulated environment would also be an advantage.

What are you waiting for?

Apply now with your CV and cover letter telling us why you’re the perfect fit for this opportunity.

For more information visit us at Careers at RWWA or contact us at

TalentAcquisition@rwwa.com.au

As part of the recruitment process, you will be required to complete Pre-Employment screening, which will include two reference checks, police clearance and Australian Working Rights check.

Please note this role is only open to applicants that hold Australian Working Rights, and we do not offer Work Sponsorship Visa's.

Additional benefits

  • Personal learning and development budget
  • 17.5% loading on Annual Leave
  • Health and wellness initiatives to support you inside and out
  • Access to discounts at a wide range of retailers
  • Reward and Recognition Program

At Racing and Wagering WA, we recognise that we are strengthened by diversity of gender, thought, experience, and ethnicity. We are committed to providing a safe work environment and making reasonable adjustments in which everyone is included and treated fairly.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply.

Applications will close on 2nd October 2026

A Brief Overview

This critical role provides the full range of support necessary for regular, terminal, and isolation cleaning. Perform daily maintenance and major restoration of hard and carpeted surface areas in accordance with department and Wellstar Health System policies and procedures. Perform cleaning using the step process in areas as assigned. Conduct project cleaning of walls, entrances, common areas, windows vents, sidewalks, etc. as assigned. Actively participate in outstanding customer service and accept responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all. More general duties include the following; 1) Proper removal, placement and transporting of waste (i.e. Solid, Chemotherapy, Bio-Hazard, Pharmaceutical, & Hot), recyclables, and other regulated materials; 2) Proper use of Ultra Violet Light devices; and 3) Changing out, removal and replacement of containers (Sharps, Pharmacy Waste, Bio-Hazard, & Chemo Therapy). Since this role is extremely visible to all stakeholders, the incumbent must have good customer service and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with staff members, guests, patients and their families. Individuals will be trained and authorized to handle the proper duties in their assigned areas.


What you will do

    • Assist in cleanup of emergency spills as requested or observed. Floor care duties include but are not limited to stripping and refinishing hard surface floors, deep cleaning of carpets and maintenance processes related to floor care.
    • Employee job duties includes the proper removal of trash and linen, ensuring that waste streams guidelines and protocol is followed based on waste type, i.e. solid waste, bio-waste, chemotherapy waste, pharmaceutical waste, etc. The transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area. Employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment.
    • Monitors and reports any equipment issues or shortages. Stocks supplies.

  • Competency/Role/Function
    • Performs the full range of restroom cleaning and complete patient room cleaning. Always following the cleaning protocol as determined by room, area, location type, i.e. regular room cleaning, terminal cleaning, isolation room cleaning, etc.
    • Follows infection prevention protocols, knowledgeable of and selects the proper chemicals to accomplish cleaning task(s).
    • Performs the full range of routine type cleaning tasks such as maintenance of wall, doors, glass/windows, furniture, equipment, floors to include dust mopping, wet mopping, corners, edges, base coves, kick plates, etc.
    • Consistently uses correct personal protective equipment (PPE) and donning and doffing techniques to ensure personal safety and that of others.
    • Consistently uses proper lifting techniques to avoid personal injury.
    • Comply with all hospital and department rules, policies and procedures.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
About the role

YouGov is consolidating established shopper analytics platforms into a single new product: the Shopper Insights Platform (SIP). SIP is rolling out across 17 European markets, with the German launch targeted for October 2027.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own go-to-market and adoption readiness for SIP: making sure the platform genuinely meets the needs of markets and clients currently served by AnalyzeIT and CIV, that launch phases are properly prepared and tested, and that the commercial model and internal teams are ready when SIP goes live. This role works closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the platform build, and with Commercial, Support, Marketing, and Sales, to bring SIP successfully to market.

This is also a strong fit for someone currently in a delivery or analytical role, whether producing outputs for external clients or internal stakeholders, who knows the shopper analytics space well and is looking to move into product management. The delivery and legacy-tool experience below matter more than a prior product title.

What you'll do

  • Validate SIP functionality against real client workflows and requirements from AnalyzeIT and CIV, working closely with the Senior PM who owns the platform build, and flagging any gaps.

  • Plan and run structured launch phases, including beta, incorporating hands-on testing with clients and pilot markets.

  • Partner with the Support team to prepare materials and readiness for the period when SIP and the legacy tools run in parallel.

  • Work with Commercial leadership on go-to-market strategy, including packaging, tiering, and market sequencing, so the commercial model reflects what the product can actually deliver.

  • Shape the product roadmap through user stories and market and commercial input, in close alignment with the Senior PM owning the build.

  • Build working relationships with Marketing, Communications, and Sales to align messaging and commercial execution around each market launch.

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Hands-on experience with shopper, retail, or consumer panel analytics platforms and workflows, ideally including YouGov's AnalyzeIT and/or CIV, or comparable tools from a similar data and insights environment.

  • Experience producing analytical deliverables, such as reports and dashboards, and answering common business questions directly for the people who use them, whether external clients or internal stakeholders.

  • Experience in a product, delivery, or analytical role (for example business analysis, insights delivery, consulting, or a stakeholder-facing analytics function), with a genuine interest in developing into or continuing in product management.

  • Comfortable working across technical, commercial, and client-facing stakeholders, and translating between them.

  • Experience with product launches or go-to-market processes.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage given the initial market focus.

Nice-to-have

  • Familiarity with the FMCG or shopper marketing data landscape.

  • Experience collaborating with commercial or sales teams on packaging, tiering, or pricing.

title: Senior Specialist Safety & Environment
description:
Job Description

Location: Rahway, NJ

Role Overview
As a core member of the Site Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) team, the Senior Specialist of Safety & Environment will provide vital technical leadership, risk management, and project ownership for operating departments at our Rahway site. This role focuses heavily on identifying, assessing, and mitigating biosafety and industrial hygiene hazards across research, development, and pilot-scale operations. You will partner closely with laboratory and clinical manufacturing departments to design, implement, and maintain compliant biological containment and technical safety solutions.

Impact and Responsibilities
You will serve as the site's primary technical resource for biological safety compliance, ensuring daily operations meet site and regulatory standards. By collaborating with scientists, facilities engineering, and site leadership, you will cultivate a robust safety culture, streamline biological material handling, and align biosafety protocols with fast-paced site business priorities.

Primary Activities:

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of site Biosafety programs, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Develop and deliver specialized biosafety training curricula (e.g., bloodborne pathogens and biological waste management).

  • Conduct comprehensive biological risk assessments for new research projects, material use, and pilot-scale processes.

  • Participate in industrial hygiene monitoring (airborne agents, chemical exposures, noise, etc.) and prepare reports pairing IH and biological risk mitigation strategies.

  • Provide hands-on oversight for biological containment systems, including Biosafety Cabinets (BSCs), laminar flow hoods, and custom containment engineering controls.

  • Perform routine laboratory safety audits, containment reviews, and technical coaching for laboratory personnel and contractors.

  • Actively support and participate in the Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC), implementing site policies, reviewing biological risk assessments, and implementing committee directives.

  • Partner with the site on capital projects and facility modifications to ensure proper HVAC, pressure cascades, and waste systems are integrated into biological spaces.

  • Support management of change (MOC) reviews, incident investigations, and Process Hazard Analyses (PHA) involving biological and chemical hazards.

  • Provide technical guidance on the handling, inactivation, and disposal of biological and hazardous waste.

  • Support site emergency response planning for potential biological spills or exposure incidents.

Position Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biosafety, Industrial Hygiene, Occupational Health & Safety, or a closely related scientific/engineering discipline. A relevant master’s degree is highly preferred.

  • Minimum 8+ years of applied professional experience in EHS, with at least 4+ years dedicated directly to biosafety, biological containment, or laboratory safety within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic research, or clinical environment.

  • Demonstrated expertise in implementing biosafety containment strategies, conducting biological risk assessments, and managing laboratory safety protocols.

  • Hands-on experience with industrial hygiene monitoring practices (airborne particulate sampling, chemical exposure assessment, and ventilation measurements).

  • Outstanding technical writing and verbal skills; proven ability to translate complex microbiological and chemical risk data into clear, actionable advice for non-EHS stakeholders.

  • Critical thinking and analytical skills to resolve complex containment and process safety challenges.

  • Self-motivated and able to lead site-wide biosafety initiatives independently while escalating program-level decisions appropriately.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Hands-on experience with biosafety technical work in laboratory and pilot-scale settings (biosafety risk assessments, containment recommendations, biosafety cabinet oversight, biological waste handling).

  • Practical experience providing general EHS support in pilot-scale and laboratory environments, including safety inspections, contractor oversight, emergency response support, and corrective action tracking.

  • Relevant professional certifications preferred: CBSP/RBP, CIH, ASP/CSP, or equivalent. Note: certification requirements can be adjusted based on hiring needs.

  • Experience preparing for and hosting regulatory inspections (e.g., OSHA) and drafting technical responses to regulatory inquiries.

  • Experience utilizing specialized EHS data systems, incident tracking software, and occupational health databases.

Required Skills:

Biosafety, Data Analysis, Emergency Response, Employee Training, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Management, Hazardous Materials Training, Incident Investigations, Industrial Hygiene, Industrial Hygiene Sampling, Occupational Safety and Health Programs, Optimism, Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Process Safety, Professional Integrity, Safety Training Programs
